blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__account_report
      description: Daily account-level ad metrics aggregated per platform from campaign report
      grain: One row per platform + normalized account_id + date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Group campaign-level rows by platform, account_id normalized by replacing NULL with ''0'' and casting to text, and date_day. - Set segmentation fields not used at account level to NULL: ad_network_type, device, interaction_event_types. - Aggregate totals across all campaigns in each group: - Sum impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, and view_through_conversions; missing values are ignored, and if all values are missing the result is NULL. - For active view sums (impressions, measurable impressions, measurable cost), treat missing row values as 0 before summing; if all inputs are missing the result is 0. - For active view averages (measurability, viewability), treat missing row values as 0 and take the unweighted average across rows. - Derived metrics (computed from the aggregated totals): - Click-through rate (percent) = total clicks / total impressions × 100, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 if total impressions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total clicks is NULL while impressions are positive. - Cost per click = total cost / total clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total clicks is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while clicks are positive. - Cost per thousand impressions = total cost / total impressions × 1000, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total impressions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while impressions are positive. - Cost per conversion = total cost / total conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if total conversions is not greater than 0; returns NULL if total cost is NULL while conversions are positive. - Return on ad spend = total conversion value / total cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 unless both totals are greater than 0. - _dbt_loaded_at is the latest timestamp across grouped rows (MAX); if all inputs are missing, the result is NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform for the aggregated row
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID with NULL replaced by '0' and cast to text; grouping key
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date at day level; grouping key
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not used in this model; always NULL
      - name: device
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not used in this model; always NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: interactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of interactions across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: cost
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of cost across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL; currency from source
      - name: conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of conversions across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversion value across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view-through conversions across campaigns; NULLs ignored; NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: active_view_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of active view impressions with missing values treated as 0; 0 if all inputs are missing
      - name: active_view_measurable_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of measurable impressions with missing values treated as 0; 0 if all inputs are missing
      - name: active_view_measurable_cost
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of measurable cost with missing values treated as 0; 0 if all inputs are missing
      - name: active_view_measurability
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of measurability with missing values treated as 0
      - name: active_view_viewability
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of viewability with missing values treated as 0
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CTR in percent: (total clicks/total impressions)×100, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 if impressions not > 0; NULL if clicks total is NULL while impressions are positive'
      - name: cost_per_click
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CPC: total cost/total clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if clicks not > 0; NULL if cost total is NULL while clicks are positive'
      - name: cost_per_thousand_impressions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CPM: total cost/total impressions×1000, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if impressions not > 0; NULL if cost total is NULL while impressions are positive'
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CPA: total cost/total conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if conversions not > 0; NULL if cost total is NULL while conversions are positive'
      - name: return_on_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'ROAS: total conversion value/total cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 unless both totals are greater than 0'
      - name: interaction_event_types
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not used in this model; always NULL
      - name: _dbt_loaded_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Latest load timestamp across grouped rows; NULL if all inputs are NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__ad_group_report
      description: Standardized Amazon Ads ad group report with derived metrics and placeholders for unsupported fields
      grain: One row per source record from staging.stg_amazon_ads__ad_group_report (duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__ad_group_report
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__ad_group_report; no joins or aggregations are performed; no ordering is applied. - Set platform to the constant string "amazon_ads". - Keys and references: - ad_group_id is converted to text (VARCHAR) from the source value; date_day is passed through; account_id and campaign_id are set to NULL. - Attributes unsupported by Amazon Ads in ad group reports are set to NULL: ad_network_type, device. - Performance metrics: - impressions and clicks default to 0 when missing; interactions is a constant 0. - Cost: - cost defaults to 0 when missing. - Conversions and view-through: - conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions are constants 0 (not provided at ad group level). - Viewability metrics: - active_view_impressions, active_view_measurable_impressions, active_view_measurable_cost, active_view_measurability, active_view_viewability are set to NULL. - Amazon-attribution metrics: - attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d are constants 0. - Derived metrics are computed from the original source values (before defaults to 0 are applied) with explicit rounding: - click_through_rate: when source impressions > 0, compute (source clicks ÷ source impressions) × 100 and round to 4 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source clicks is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_click: when source clicks > 0, compute source cost ÷ source clicks and round to 2 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source cost is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: when source impressions > 0, compute (source cost ÷ source impressions) × 1000 and round to 2 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source cost is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_conversion: always 0 (no conversions). - return_on_ad_spend: always 0 (no revenue/conversions). - interaction_event_types is set to NULL; _dbt_loaded_at is passed through from the source.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant string 'amazon_ads' identifying the source platform
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Account identifier; always NULL in this model
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier stored as text from the source without trimming or case changes
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Report date passed through from source
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Campaign identifier; always NULL in this model
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Ad network type; not applicable for Amazon Ads and set to NULL
      - name: device
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Device segmentation; not applicable for Amazon Ads and set to NULL
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impression count with NULLs treated as 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Click count with NULLs treated as 0
      - name: interactions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Interaction count; constant 0 as Amazon Ads does not track interactions here
      - name: cost
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Ad spend with NULLs treated as 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Conversion count; constant 0 (not available at ad group level)
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Conversion value; constant 0 (not available at ad group level)
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: View-through conversions; constant 0 (not tracked)
      - name: active_view_impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View impressions; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: active_view_measurable_impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurable impressions; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: active_view_measurable_cost
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurable cost; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: active_view_measurability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurability; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: active_view_viewability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View viewability; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: attributed_sales_14_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed sales within 14 days; constant 0
      - name: attributed_sales_30_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed sales within 30 days; constant 0
      - name: attributed_conversions_14_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed conversions within 14 days; constant 0
      - name: attributed_conversions_30_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed conversions within 30 days; constant 0
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CTR percent; when source impressions > 0 compute clicks ÷ impressions × 100 rounded to 4 decimals, else 0; NULL if clicks is NULL in the computation branch
      - name: cost_per_click
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CPC; when source clicks > 0 compute cost ÷ clicks rounded to 2 decimals, else 0; NULL if cost is NULL in the computation branch
      - name: cost_per_thousand_impressions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CPM; when source impressions > 0 compute cost ÷ impressions × 1000 rounded to 2 decimals, else 0; NULL if cost is NULL in the computation branch
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion; constant 0 due to no conversions
      - name: return_on_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: ROAS; constant 0 due to no revenue/conversions
      - name: interaction_event_types
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Interaction event types; set to NULL (not available)
      - name: _dbt_loaded_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: ETL load timestamp passed through from source

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__ad_group_report; no joins or aggregations are performed; no ordering is applied. - Set platform to the constant string "amazon_ads". - Keys and references: - ad_group_id is converted to text (VARCHAR) from the source value; date_day is passed through; account_id and campaign_id are set to NULL. - Attributes unsupported by Amazon Ads in ad group reports are set to NULL: ad_network_type, device. - Performance metrics: - impressions and clicks default to 0 when missing; interactions is a constant 0. - Cost: - cost defaults to 0 when missing. - Conversions and view-through: - conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions are constants 0 (not provided at ad group level). - Viewability metrics: - active_view_impressions, active_view_measurable_impressions, active_view_measurable_cost, active_view_measurability, active_view_viewability are set to NULL. - Amazon-attribution metrics: - attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d are constants 0. - Derived metrics are computed from the original source values (before defaults to 0 are applied) with explicit rounding: - click_through_rate: when source impressions > 0, compute (source clicks ÷ source impressions) × 100 and round to 4 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source clicks is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_click: when source clicks > 0, compute source cost ÷ source clicks and round to 2 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source cost is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: when source impressions > 0, compute (source cost ÷ source impressions) × 1000 and round to 2 decimal places; otherwise 0; if source cost is NULL in the computation branch, the result is NULL. - cost_per_conversion: always 0 (no conversions). - return_on_ad_spend: always 0 (no revenue/conversions). - interaction_event_types is set to NULL; _dbt_loaded_at is passed through from the source.'

- name: int_ad_reporting__ad_report
      description: Unified ad-level report standardizing Facebook Ads and Apple Search Ads by appending source rows
      grain: One row per (platform, ad_id, date_day) source record; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report
      - staging.stg_apple_search_ads__ad_report
      business_logic: '- Build a standardized ad report by stacking rows from the two source models; no aggregation, filtering, or reordering; original row multiplicity is preserved. - Facebook Ads mapping: - account_id from source; campaign_id NULL; ad_group_id NULL; ad_network_type NULL; device NULL. - impressions from source; clicks from inline_link_clicks; interactions set to 0. - cost from spend. - conversions set to 0; conversions_value set to 0.0; view_through_conversions set to 0. - active_view_* fields NULL. - attributed_* fields NULL. - installs NULL; taps NULL. - click_through_rate from source; cost_per_click from source; cost_per_thousand_impressions from source; cost_per_conversion set to 0.0; return_on_ad_spend set to 0.0. - interaction_event_types NULL; _dbt_loaded_at passed through. - Apple Search Ads mapping: - account_id NULL; campaign_id from source; ad_group_id from source; ad_network_type NULL; device NULL. - impressions converted to integer; clicks from taps converted to integer; interactions set to 0. - cost from spend. - conversions from source; conversions_value set to 0.0; view_through_conversions set to 0. - active_view_* fields NULL. - attributed_* fields NULL. - installs from new_downloads converted to integer; taps converted to integer. - click_through_rate from tap_through_rate; cost_per_click from cost_per_tap; cost_per_thousand_impressions set to 0.0; cost_per_conversion from source; return_on_ad_spend set to 0.0. - interaction_event_types NULL; _dbt_loaded_at passed through. - Numeric constants: 0 is used for integer columns; 0.0 is used for decimal/double columns. Conversions to integer are performed where noted; no other rounding is applied. NULLs are set exactly as indicated.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      description: Unified campaign-level metrics for ad reporting (currently Amazon Ads only)
      grain: One row per source row in staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report; no joins, filters, or aggregations; preserve source duplicates. - Set platform to the constant "amazon_ads". - Identifiers and attributes: - campaign_id: convert to string; date_day: passthrough. - account_id, campaign_name, ad_network_type, device: set to NULL (not provided by Amazon Ads campaign report). - Standardize metrics: - Replace NULL with 0 for impressions, clicks, cost, conversions (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases), conversions_value (mapped from 30-day attributed sales), attributed_sales_14_d (mapped from 7-day attributed sales), attributed_sales_30_d (mapped from 30-day attributed sales), attributed_conversions_14_d (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases), and attributed_conversions_30_d (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases). - interactions and view_through_conversions are set to 0. - Active View metrics (impressions, measurable_impressions, measurable_cost, measurability, viewability) are set to NULL. - Calculated metrics (rounding and denominator checks): - All calculations use the original source values for inputs; if the denominator is NULL or not greater than 0, return 0; otherwise perform the division and round as specified. If the numerator is NULL when computing, the result is NULL. - click_through_rate: clicks divided by impressions times 100, rounded to 4 decimals. - cost_per_click: cost divided by clicks, rounded to 2 decimals. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: cost divided by impressions times 1000, rounded to 2 decimals. - cost_per_conversion: cost divided by 30-day attributed purchases, rounded to 2 decimals. - return_on_ad_spend: 30-day attributed sales value divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost or sales value is not greater than 0 or is NULL. - interaction_event_types is set to NULL; _dbt_loaded_at is a direct passthrough from the source.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant platform identifier 'amazon_ads'.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to NULL (not available in Amazon Ads campaign report).
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier converted to string from source.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date from source.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to NULL (not provided by Amazon Ads campaign report).
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to NULL (concept not present in Amazon Ads campaign report).
      - name: device
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to NULL (no device segmentation in Amazon Ads campaign report).
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impression count with NULL replaced by 0.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Click count with NULL replaced by 0.
      - name: interactions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to 0 (Amazon Ads does not track interactions).
      - name: cost
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Ad spend with NULL replaced by 0.
      - name: conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 30-day attributed conversions with NULL replaced by 0.
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: 30-day attributed sales value with NULL replaced by 0.
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Set to 0 (not tracked by Amazon Ads).
      - name: active_view_impressions

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report; no joins, filters, or aggregations; preserve source duplicates. - Set platform to the constant "amazon_ads". - Identifiers and attributes: - campaign_id: convert to string; date_day: passthrough. - account_id, campaign_name, ad_network_type, device: set to NULL (not provided by Amazon Ads campaign report). - Standardize metrics: - Replace NULL with 0 for impressions, clicks, cost, conversions (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases), conversions_value (mapped from 30-day attributed sales), attributed_sales_14_d (mapped from 7-day attributed sales), attributed_sales_30_d (mapped from 30-day attributed sales), attributed_conversions_14_d (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases), and attributed_conversions_30_d (mapped from 30-day attributed purchases). - interactions and view_through_conversions are set to 0. - Active View metrics (impressions, measurable_impressions, measurable_cost, measurability, viewability) are set to NULL. - Calculated metrics (rounding and denominator checks): - All calculations use the original source values for inputs; if the denominator is NULL or not greater than 0, return 0; otherwise perform the division and round as specified. If the numerator is NULL when computing, the result is NULL. - click_through_rate: clicks divided by impressions times 100, rounded to 4 decimals. - cost_per_click: cost divided by clicks, rounded to 2 decimals. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: cost divided by impressions times 1000, rounded to 2 decimals. - cost_per_conversion: cost divided by 30-day attributed purchases, rounded to 2 decimals. - return_on_ad_spend: 30-day attributed sales value divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost or sales value is not greater than 0 or is NULL. - interaction_event_types is set to NULL; _dbt_loaded_at is a direct passthrough from the source.'

- name: int_ad_reporting__country_mapping
      description: Static country mapping for ad reporting with regions, codes, market flags, and platform availability
      grain: One row per country_code
      source_models:
      - inline VALUES dataset in SQL
      business_logic: '- Build a static mapping from an inline enumerated list of country rows spanning North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa, and Latin America. - Emit all fields exactly as listed: strings keep original casing and spacing; booleans and numerics pass through without transformation or rounding; the list provides a value for every column in every row. - Add a loaded-at timestamp set to the query execution time; the same timestamp is applied to all rows within a single run. - Order rows by region ascending, then by country_name ascending. - No joins, filters, aggregations, or de-duplication are performed; the result contains exactly one row per country_code as enumerated.'
      columns:
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 uppercase country code; primary grain.
      - name: country_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Official country name with original casing and spacing.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level region label used for primary sort.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subregion classification.
      - name: continent
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Continent classification.
      - name: iso_alpha_3_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 uppercase country code.
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO 4217 currency code in uppercase.
      - name: timezone_primary
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary IANA timezone identifier.
      - name: population_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Estimated population (persons) as integer.
      - name: gdp_per_capita_usd
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: GDP per capita in USD as integer.
      - name: internet_penetration_pct
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Share of population with internet access; one decimal place.
      - name: mobile_penetration_pct
        data_type: DECIMAL(4,1)
        description: Mobile subscriptions per 100 people; can exceed 100; one decimal place.
      - name: is_developed_market
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating a developed market.
      - name: is_advertising_market
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating inclusion as an addressable advertising market.
      - name: platform_availability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Availability category: ''All platforms'', ''Most platforms'', or ''Limited platforms''.'
      - name: _dbt_loaded_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp with time zone captured at execution; identical for all rows in a run.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis
      description: Aggregated customer journey metrics and classifications across ad platforms (one row per customer within the last 12 months)
      grain: One row per customer_identifier with first_interaction_date within the last 12 months
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      - raw.facebook_ads_basic_ad_data
      business_logic: '- Build customer_touchpoints by unifying: - Google Ads: platform=''google_ads''; use account_id as both customer_id and account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, spend as cost, conversions, conversions_value; keep only rows with account_id present. - Amazon Ads: platform=''amazon_ads''; no customer_id or account_id; include campaign_id, date_day, impressions, clicks, cost, purchases_30_d as conversions, sales_30_d as revenue_30d. - Facebook Ads: platform=''facebook_ads''; no customer_id; use account_id; set campaign_id from ad_id (as text), date_day from date; include impressions, inline_link_clicks as clicks, spend as cost; set conversions to 0. - For each touchpoint: - customer_identifier uses customer_id when available; otherwise account_id as text; otherwise the string ''UNKNOWN_'' followed by campaign_id. - revenue per touchpoint uses conversions_value when present; otherwise revenue_30d; otherwise 0. - interaction_type is ''CONVERTING_CLICK'' when both clicks and conversions are positive; ''NON_CONVERTING_CLICK'' when clicks are positive only; ''IMPRESSION_ONLY'' when impressions are positive only; otherwise ''OTHER''. - Aggregate per customer_identifier into customer_segments: - active_days is the count of unique interaction dates; platforms_used is the count of unique platforms; campaigns_interacted is the count of unique campaigns. - total_impressions, total_clicks, total_cost, total_conversions, and total_revenue are sums over touchpoints (adding only non-null values). - first_interaction_date is the earliest interaction date; blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__geo_channel_performance
      description: Geographic-channel monthly ad performance with growth, percentiles, and opportunity classifications
      grain: One row per country_code, region, marketing_channel, performance_month
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      - raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data
      business_logic: 'Standardize and union campaign-day data from three ad platforms: - google_ads: use account_id as account_identifier; include campaign_id, date_day, clicks, impressions, spend as cost, conversions, and conversions_value as revenue; set platform=''google_ads'', country_code=''UNITED_STATES'', region=''NORTH_AMERICA'', local_currency=''USD''. - amazon_ads: set account_identifier to a constant (''AMZ_ACCOUNT''); include campaign_id, date_day, clicks, impressions, cost, purchases_30_d as conversions, and sales_30_d as revenue; set platform=''amazon_ads'', country_code=''UNITED_STATES'', region=''NORTH_AMERICA''; keep the reported budget currency as local_currency. - linkedin_ads: use campaign_id as account_identifier; include campaign_id, day (as a date), clicks, impressions (cast to integer), cost_in_usd (cast to numeric) as cost; derive conversions from conversion_value_in_local_currency (cast to integer, missing as 0); set revenue to 0; set platform=''linkedin_ads'', country_code=''UNITED_STATES'', region=''NORTH_AMERICA'', local_currency=''USD''; include only rows where cost_in_usd is non-negative. Aggregate the last 12 months by country_code, region, platform, and calendar month of date_day: - Market participants and volume: distinct advertisers (active_advertisers), distinct campaigns (active_campaigns), total impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, and revenue; count distinct active days (active_days_in_month). - Penetration: campaigns_per_advertiser is distinct campaigns divided by distinct advertisers (as a floating number). - KPIs with rounding and zero handling: CTR as percentage with four decimals, set to 0 when impressions are 0; CPC with two decimals, set to 0 when clicks are 0; CPM (per 1,000 impressions) with two decimals, set to 0 when impressions are 0; CPA with two decimals, set to 0 when conversions are 0; ROAS with four decimals, set to 0 unless both spend and revenue are positive. - Competitive intensity: variance and standard deviation of per-row CPC within the month; rows with zero clicks are excluded; results can be NULL if no valid values exist. Final filtering and enrichments: - Keep only months within the last six months where total_spend and total_impressions are both greater than zero. - Rename platform to marketing_channel. - Opportunity tier: HIGH_OPPORTUNITY when ROAS ≥ 3.0 and CTR ≥ 2.0; MEDIUM_OPPORTUNITY when ROAS ≥ 2.0 or CTR ≥ 1.0; OPTIMIZATION_NEEDED when ROAS < 1.0 and CTR < 0.5; otherwise MONITOR. - Growth: prev_month_spend is the previous month’s total_spend within the same country and channel after filtering; month_over_month_spend_growth is the percent change versus the previous month, rounded to two decimals, set to 0 when the previous month’s spend is not positive; the value can be negative. - Maturity tier: MATURE when active_advertisers ≥ 50 and campaigns_per_advertiser ≥ 3; DEVELOPING when active_advertisers ≥ 20 and campaigns_per_advertiser ≥ 2; EMERGING when active_advertisers ≥ 10; otherwise NASCENT. - Percentiles: spend_share_percentile is the relative position (0–1) within region and month by total_spend; performance_percentile is the relative position (0–1) within region and month by CTR. - Multi-channel metrics: avg_daily_platform_diversity is set to 1; multi_channel_advertisers equals active_advertisers; single_channel_advertisers is 0. - Analysis metadata: analysis_generated_at is the timestamp at query runtime. - Final ordering: rows are sorted by region, country_code, marketing_channel, and performance_month descending.'
      columns:
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Standardized country for the traffic (constant 'UNITED_STATES' in current logic)
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Standardized geographic region (constant 'NORTH_AMERICA' in current logic)
      - name: marketing_channel
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform label derived from source (google_ads, amazon_ads, linkedin_ads)
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar month derived from date_day
      - name: active_advertisers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of advertisers active in the month
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of campaigns active in the month
      - name: campaigns_per_advertiser
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of distinct campaigns to distinct advertisers in the month
      - name: active_days_in_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct days with any activity in the month
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions in the month (must be > 0 after final filter)
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks in the month
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of spend in the month (must be > 0 after final filter)
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of platform-reported conversions in the month
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of platform-reported revenue in the month
      - name: market_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate as a percentage (four decimals; 0 when impressions are 0)
      - name: market_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per click (two decimals; 0 when clicks are 0)
      - name: market_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per 1,000 impressions (two decimals; 0 when impressions are 0)
      - name: market_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per conversion (two decimals; 0 when conversions are 0)
      - name: market_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue divided by spend (four decimals; 0 when spend or revenue is not positive)
      - name: cpc_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Variance of per-row CPC within the month (excludes rows with clicks=0; may be NULL)
      - name: cpc_std_dev
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of per-row CPC within the month (excludes rows with clicks=0; may be NULL)
      - name: market_opportunity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier from ROAS and CTR thresholds (HIGH_OPPORTUNITY, MEDIUM_OPPORTUNITY, OPTIMIZATION_NEEDED, MONITOR)
      - name: prev_month_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Previous month’s total_spend within the same country and channel after filtering; NULL if none
      - name: month_over_month_spend_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus prev_month_spend (two decimals; 0 when prev_month_spend is not positive; can be negative)
      - name: market_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Maturity tier based on advertiser count and campaigns per advertiser
      - name: spend_share_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) within region and month by total_spend
      - name: performance_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) within region and month by CTR
      - name: avg_daily_platform_diversity
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified platform diversity metric set to 1
      - name: multi_channel_advertisers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Simplified count set equal to active_advertisers
      - name: single_channel_advertisers
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified count set to 0
      - name: analysis_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp at query runtime

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__keyword_report
      description: Intermediate keyword-level unified report (Amazon Ads only) with standardized fields and derived CTR/CPC/CPM/CPA/ROAS
      grain: One row per source record (keyword_id, date_day, campaign_id, ad_group_id) from staging.stg_amazon_ads__keyword_report; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__keyword_report
      business_logic: '- Rows are passed through from staging.stg_amazon_ads__keyword_report; no joins, filters, de-duplication, or ordering. - Set platform to "amazon_ads". - Cast keyword_id to VARCHAR; pass through date_day, campaign_id, ad_group_id, keyword_type, match_type; set account_id = NULL and keyword_text = NULL. - Metrics null handling: - impressions and clicks: replace NULL with 0; interactions: constant 0. - cost: replace NULL with 0 (2-decimal currency). - conversions: use attributed_conversions_30_d with NULL replaced by 0. - conversions_value: use attributed_sales_30_d with NULL replaced by 0 (2-decimal currency). - view_through_conversions: constant 0. - attributed_sales_14_d/30_d and attributed_conversions_14_d/30_d: replace NULL with 0. - quality_score, first_page_cpc, top_of_page_cpc, first_position_cpc, search_impression_share, search_rank_lost_impression_share, search_budget_lost_impression_share: always NULL. - Derived metrics are calculated from raw source values before zero-filling: - click_through_rate: if impressions > 0, compute (clicks ÷ impressions) × 100 and round to 4 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when impressions > 0 and clicks is NULL. - cost_per_click: if clicks > 0, compute cost ÷ clicks and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when clicks > 0 and cost is NULL. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: if impressions > 0, compute (cost ÷ impressions) × 1,000 and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when impressions > 0 and cost is NULL. - cost_per_conversion: if attributed_conversions_30_d > 0, compute cost ÷ conversions and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when conversions > 0 and cost is NULL. - return_on_ad_spend: if cost > 0 and attributed_sales_30_d > 0, compute sales ÷ cost and round to 4 decimals; otherwise 0; never NULL. - _dbt_loaded_at is passed through unchanged.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Literal 'amazon_ads' for all rows
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword identifier cast to VARCHAR; duplicates preserved; NULLs remain NULL
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Day-level report date passed through from source
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Account identifier; always NULL for Amazon Ads keyword report
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier passed through from source
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier passed through from source
      - name: keyword_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword type/category passed through from source
      - name: match_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword match type (e.g., exact, phrase) passed through from source
      - name: keyword_text
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Keyword text; always NULL in current Amazon Ads source
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impressions; NULLs become 0; never NULL
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Clicks; NULLs become 0; never NULL
      - name: interactions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Total interactions; constant 0 for Amazon Ads
      - name: cost
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Total cost; NULLs become 0; 2-decimal currency; never NULL
      - name: conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed conversions (30-day); NULLs become 0; never NULL
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Attributed sales value (30-day); NULLs become 0; 2-decimal currency; never NULL
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: View-through conversions; constant 0 for Amazon Ads
      - name: attributed_sales_14_d
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Attributed sales within 14 days; NULLs become 0; 2-decimal currency; never NULL
      - name: attributed_sales_30_d
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Attributed sales within 30 days; NULLs become 0; 2-decimal currency; never NULL
      - name: attributed_conversions_14_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed conversions within 14 days; NULLs become 0; never NULL
      - name: attributed_conversions_30_d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Attributed conversions within 30 days; NULLs become 0; never NULL
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Quality score; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: first_page_cpc
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: First page CPC; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: top_of_page_cpc
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Top of page CPC; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: first_position_cpc
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: First position CPC; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: search_impression_share
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Search impression share; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: search_rank_lost_impression_share
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Search rank lost impression share; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: search_budget_lost_impression_share
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Search budget lost impression share; always NULL for Amazon Ads in this model
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks ÷ impressions × 100, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 if impressions ≤ 0 or NULL; NULL if impressions > 0 and clicks is NULL
      - name: cost_per_click
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost ÷ clicks rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if clicks ≤ 0 or NULL; NULL if clicks > 0 and cost is NULL
      - name: cost_per_thousand_impressions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per 1,000 impressions rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if impressions ≤ 0 or NULL; NULL if impressions > 0 and cost is NULL
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost ÷ attributed conversions (30-day) rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if conversions ≤ 0 or NULL; NULL if conversions > 0 and cost is NULL
      - name: return_on_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Attributed sales (30-day) ÷ cost rounded to 4 decimals; 0 if cost ≤ 0 or sales ≤ 0 or either is NULL; never NULL
      - name: _dbt_loaded_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Source data load timestamp passed through from staging

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Rows are passed through from staging.stg_amazon_ads__keyword_report; no joins, filters, de-duplication, or ordering. - Set platform to "amazon_ads". - Cast keyword_id to VARCHAR; pass through date_day, campaign_id, ad_group_id, keyword_type, match_type; set account_id = NULL and keyword_text = NULL. - Metrics null handling: - impressions and clicks: replace NULL with 0; interactions: constant 0. - cost: replace NULL with 0 (2-decimal currency). - conversions: use attributed_conversions_30_d with NULL replaced by 0. - conversions_value: use attributed_sales_30_d with NULL replaced by 0 (2-decimal currency). - view_through_conversions: constant 0. - attributed_sales_14_d/30_d and attributed_conversions_14_d/30_d: replace NULL with 0. - quality_score, first_page_cpc, top_of_page_cpc, first_position_cpc, search_impression_share, search_rank_lost_impression_share, search_budget_lost_impression_share: always NULL. - Derived metrics are calculated from raw source values before zero-filling: - click_through_rate: if impressions > 0, compute (clicks ÷ impressions) × 100 and round to 4 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when impressions > 0 and clicks is NULL. - cost_per_click: if clicks > 0, compute cost ÷ clicks and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when clicks > 0 and cost is NULL. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: if impressions > 0, compute (cost ÷ impressions) × 1,000 and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when impressions > 0 and cost is NULL. - cost_per_conversion: if attributed_conversions_30_d > 0, compute cost ÷ conversions and round to 2 decimals; otherwise 0; returns NULL when conversions > 0 and cost is NULL. - return_on_ad_spend: if cost > 0 and attributed_sales_30_d > 0, compute sales ÷ cost and round to 4 decimals; otherwise 0; never NULL. - _dbt_loaded_at is passed through unchanged.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__monthly_campaign_country_report
      description: Monthly campaign-level country rollup across ad platforms with aggregated metrics and derived KPIs; country_code is statically mapped by platform
      grain: One row per (platform, country_code, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, month_year)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Source rows come from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report and must have a non-null date_day. - Derive country_code by platform: google_ads → US, facebook_ads → US, amazon_ads → US, otherwise Unknown. - Derive time fields: month_year as the first day of the month for date_day; year and month as the calendar year and month of date_day. - Group by platform, country_code, month_year, year, month, account_id, campaign_id, and campaign_name. - Aggregate totals over each group: - Standard totals (impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions) sum available values; the result is null if all inputs are null. - Platform-specific totals (active_view_impressions, active_view_measurable_impressions, attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d) treat missing values as zero before summing. - Compute monthly KPIs using the aggregated totals: - Click-through rate: 100 × total_clicks / total_impressions, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_impressions is not positive. - Cost per click: total_cost / total_clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_clicks is not positive. - Cost per thousand impressions: 1000 × total_cost / total_impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_impressions is not positive. - Cost per conversion: total_cost / total_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when total_conversions is not positive. - Return on ad spend: total_conversions_value / total_cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_cost or total_conversions_value is not positive. - Amazon 30-day ROAS: total_attributed_sales_30_d / total_cost, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when total_cost or total_attributed_sales_30_d is not positive. - Activity and averages: - days_active_in_month is the count of distinct date_day values in the group. - avg_daily_spend is total_cost divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 2 decimals; null when total_cost is null. - avg_daily_impressions is total_impressions divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 0 decimals; null when total_impressions is null. - avg_daily_clicks is total_clicks divided by days_active_in_month, rounded to 0 decimals; null when total_clicks is null. - Data quality fields: first_active_date is the earliest date_day in the group; last_active_date is the latest; _dbt_loaded_at is the execution timestamp. - Filter: keep groups where at least one of total_impressions, total_clicks, or total_cost is greater than zero; exclude groups with zero or null across all three. - Result ordering when queried: platform, country_code, then month_year descending, then total_cost descending (ordering is not persisted).'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform identifier sourced as-is; nulls, if present, are grouped separately.
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived country: US for google_ads, facebook_ads, and amazon_ads; Unknown for all others.'
      - name: month_year
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month for date_day; defines the monthly bucket.
      - name: year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year extracted from date_day.
      - name: month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month (1–12) extracted from date_day.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Account identifier from the source; part of the grouping key.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from the source; part of the grouping key.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Campaign name or label from the source stored as an integer; grouped by exact value.
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_interactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of interactions within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_cost
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of cost within the group in source currency; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of conversions within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversions_value within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view-through conversions within the group; null when all source values are null.
      - name: total_active_view_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of active view impressions with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: total_active_view_measurable_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of measurable active view impressions with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: total_attributed_sales_14_d
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of attributed sales within 14 days with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: total_attributed_sales_30_d
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of attributed sales within 30 days with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: total_attributed_conversions_14_d
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of attributed conversions within 14 days with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: total_attributed_conversions_30_d
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of attributed conversions within 30 days with missing values treated as zero before summing.
      - name: monthly_click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of clicks over impressions, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when impressions are not positive.
      - name: monthly_cost_per_click
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per click, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when clicks are not positive.
      - name: monthly_cost_per_thousand_impressions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per thousand impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when impressions are not positive.
      - name: monthly_cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cost per conversion, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when conversions are not positive.
      - name: monthly_return_on_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue-to-cost ratio using conversions_value, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost or conversions_value are not positive.
      - name: monthly_amazon_roas_30d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Amazon-specific 30-day ROAS, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when cost or attributed_sales_30_d are not positive.
      - name: days_active_in_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of active dates in the month for the group; always at least 1.
      - name: avg_daily_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily spend (total_cost ÷ days_active_in_month), rounded to 2 decimals; null when total_cost is null.
      - name: avg_daily_impressions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily impressions (total_impressions ÷ days_active_in_month), rounded to 0 decimals; null when total_impressions is null.
      - name: avg_daily_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily clicks (total_clicks ÷ days_active_in_month), rounded to 0 decimals; null when total_clicks is null.
      - name: first_active_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest date_day observed in the group.
      - name: last_active_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest date_day observed in the group.
      - name: _dbt_loaded_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp captured at model run; time zone preserved.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__search_report
      description: Intermediate Amazon Ads search term performance model with standardized metrics and derived rates
      grain: One row per input record from staging.stg_amazon_ads__search_report (per search_term × date_day × campaign_id × ad_group_id × keyword_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__search_report
      business_logic: '- Source rows are passed through without filtering or aggregation; one output row per source row. - Set platform to the constant value ''amazon_ads''. - Carry over identifiers: search_term (cast to text), date_day, campaign_id, ad_group_id, keyword_id; set account_id to null. - Carry over attributes: match_type and query; set search_term_match_type to null. - Replace nulls with zero for numeric metrics: impressions, clicks, cost, attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d. - Set interactions and view_through_conversions to 0. - Map conversions to 30-day attributed conversions and conversions_value to 30-day attributed sales (both after nulls are replaced with zero). - Text features: search_term_length is the number of characters in search_term; search_term_word_count is the number of space-delimited words; both are null if search_term is null. - Set relevance and coverage metrics to null: quality_score, search_impression_share, search_exact_match_impression_share, search_rank_lost_impression_share, search_budget_lost_impression_share. - Derived metrics (computed after nulls are replaced with zero): - click_through_rate: clicks divided by impressions, multiplied by 100, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when impressions is 0. - cost_per_click: cost divided by clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when clicks is 0. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: cost divided by impressions, multiplied by 1,000, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when impressions is 0. - cost_per_conversion: cost divided by 30-day attributed conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when conversions is 0. - return_on_ad_spend: 30-day attributed sales divided by cost, rounded to 4 decimals; returns 0 when either cost or sales is 0. - Pass through _dbt_loaded_at.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant platform identifier set to 'amazon_ads'
      - name: search_term
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Search term text cast to VARCHAR; may be null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date passed through from source
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not provided by Amazon search report and always null
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier passed through from source
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier passed through from source
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword identifier passed through from source
      - name: match_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword match type passed through from source
      - name: query
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reported query string passed through from source

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_ad_reporting__time_series_analytics
      description: Advanced daily ad performance time series with moving averages, trends, anomalies, seasonality, forecasts, and recommendations (per platform, last 12 months)
      grain: One row per (date_day, platform)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report (date_day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, conversions_value)
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report (date_day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, cost, purchases_30_d, sales_30_d)
      - raw.facebook_ads_basic_ad_data (date, ad_id, impressions, inline_link_clicks, spend)
      - raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data (day, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, cost_in_usd, conversion_value_in_local_currency)
      business_logic: '- Ingest four ad sources, align fields, and union: - google_ads: cost comes from spend; conversions and conversion value as provided. - amazon_ads: conversions come from purchases_30_d; revenue uses sales_30_d; no conversion value. - facebook_ads: date is converted to date_day; ad_id is treated as the campaign identifier; conversions set to 0; clicks use inline_link_clicks; cost from spend. - linkedin_ads: day is converted to date_day; ensure impressions and cost are numeric; conversions use conversion_value_in_local_currency as an integer count; exclude rows with negative cost_in_usd. - Keep only records with date_day in the last 18 months, then aggregate by date_day and platform: - Sums: impressions, clicks, cost (spend), conversions, revenue (conversion value when present, else 30‑day revenue; missing treated as 0). - KPIs: CTR = 100×(clicks/impressions) rounded to 4 decimals when impressions>0, else 0; CPC = spend/clicks rounded to 2 decimals when clicks>0, else 0; CPA = spend/conversions rounded to 2 decimals when conversions>0, else 0; ROAS = revenue/spend rounded to 4 decimals when both >0, else 0. - Campaign indicators: active_campaigns = distinct campaigns; campaigns_with_clicks = distinct campaigns with clicks>0; market_active_day = 1 when total impressions>0, else 0. - Derive calendar features: day_of_week (0=Sun..6=Sat), week_of_year, month_of_year, quarter_of_year, day_type (WEEKEND when Sun/Sat else WEEKDAY), month_period (EARLY/MID/LATE/END by day of month), and seasonal_period using explicit US seasonal date rules. For trend math, compute days since 1970‑01‑01 as a whole‑day index. - Rolling metrics are computed per platform ordered by date_day and include the current day; if fewer than N days exist, use the available days: - Moving averages: last 7 days (spend, ctr, cpc), last 30 days (spend, ctr, cpc), and last 90 days (spend). - spend_ewma is approximated as the same 7‑day simple average of spend. - Volatility: sample standard deviation over the last 30 days for ctr and cpc. - Trend and seasonality: - 90‑day rolling linear trend slopes for spend and ctr using the day index (days since epoch). - Prior‑period references: values from 365, 30, and 7 days earlier for YoY, MoM, and WoW comparisons. - Baselines: average ctr and spend by day_of_week, and by month_of_year, over the available 18‑month input window. - Anomalies and momentum: - Percent change vs prior periods is computed when the prior value is >0; otherwise NULL. - z‑scores are absolute deviations from the 30‑day mean scaled by the 30‑day standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation is not positive. - Day‑of‑week deviation is the absolute percent difference from the day‑of‑week average; NULL when the baseline is zero. - Momentum: spend is ACCELERATING when the 7‑day average exceeds 110% of the 30‑day average, DECELERATING when below 90%, else STABLE; ctr is IMPROVING when the 7‑day average exceeds 105% of the 30‑day average, DECLINING when below 95%, else STABLE. - Trend direction from the 90‑day spend slope: STRONG_UPTREND (>0.1), MILD_UPTREND (>0 to 0.1], STRONG_DOWNTREND (<-0.1), MILD_DOWNTREND (<0 to -0.1], else SIDEWAYS. - Forecasting and confidence: - 30‑day trend forecasts add 30 times the 90‑day slope to the 30‑day average (for spend and ctr). - Seasonal factors are ratios of the daily values to the corresponding monthly averages; NULL when the monthly average is zero. - Confidence bounds are the 30‑day average minus/plus two 30‑day standard deviations. - Market signals and actions: - market_state precedence: ANOMALOUS when ctr_z_score>2 or cpc_z_score>2; else VOLATILE when WoW spend change is >50% or <‑50%; else OPTIMIZING when ctr momentum is IMPROVING and spend momentum is STABLE; else SCALING when spend momentum is ACCELERATING and ctr momentum is STABLE; else NORMAL. - requires_investigation is true when ctr_z_score>3, or cpc_z_score>3, or absolute WoW spend change exceeds 200%; otherwise false. - optimization_recommendation: OPTIMIZE_TARGETING when ctr is DECLINING and spend is ACCELERATING; OPTIMIZE_BIDDING when cpc_z_score>2 and ctr momentum is STABLE; SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDED when spend seasonal factor>1.2 and ctr seasonal factor<0.8; SCALE_OPPORTUNITY when market_state is SCALING; otherwise MONITOR. - Finalize by keeping only the last 12 months, ordering by platform ascending and date_day descending, and stamping analysis_generated_at with the current timestamp.'

      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metrics; final output includes only the last 12 months
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad platform identifier ('google_ads','amazon_ads','facebook_ads','linkedin_ads')
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_of_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day of week where 0=Sunday and 6=Saturday
      - name: day_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: WEEKEND when day_of_week is 0 or 6; otherwise WEEKDAY
      - name: week_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar week number of date_day
      - name: month_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number 1–12 of date_day
      - name: quarter_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number 1–4 of date_day
      - name: seasonal_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season tag: HOLIDAY_SEASON, BLACK_FRIDAY_WEEK, SUMMER_SEASON, BACK_TO_SCHOOL_SEASON, or REGULAR_PERIOD'
      - name: month_period
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EARLY_MONTH (1–7), MID_MONTH (8–15), LATE_MONTH (16–23), or END_MONTH (24+)
      - name: daily_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of cost across all campaigns for the platform and date; LinkedIn rows with negative cost are excluded
      - name: daily_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversions across all campaigns for the platform and date
      - name: daily_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of conversion value when present, else 30‑day revenue; missing values treated as 0
      - name: daily_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If impressions>0, clicks divided by impressions times 100 rounded to 4 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If clicks>0, spend divided by clicks rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If conversions>0, spend divided by conversions rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: daily_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If spend>0 and revenue>0, revenue divided by spend rounded to 4 decimals; otherwise 0
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaign_id per platform and date (Facebook uses ad_id as campaign_id)
      - name: campaigns_with_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaign_id with clicks>0 per platform and date
      - name: market_active_day
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if total impressions>0; otherwise 0
      - name: spend_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_90d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 90‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: spend_ewma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Approximate EWMA represented as the same 7‑day moving average of daily_spend per platform
      - name: ctr_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_ctr per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: ctr_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_ctr per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: cpc_7d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7‑day moving average of daily_cpc per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: cpc_30d_ma
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30‑day moving average of daily_cpc per platform including the current day; early dates use a shorter window
      - name: ctr_30d_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 30‑day sample standard deviation of daily_ctr per platform
      - name: cpc_30d_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 30‑day sample standard deviation of daily_cpc per platform
      - name: spend_trend_slope_90d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Slope of the 90‑day rolling linear trend of daily_spend versus days since epoch (per platform)
      - name: ctr_trend_slope_90d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Slope of the 90‑day rolling linear trend of daily_ctr versus days since epoch (per platform)
      - name: spend_trend_direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend class from the 90‑day spend slope: STRONG_UPTREND, MILD_UPTREND, STRONG_DOWNTREND, MILD_DOWNTREND, or SIDEWAYS'
      - name: spend_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ACCELERATING if 7‑day spend average >110% of 30‑day; DECELERATING if <90%; else STABLE
      - name: ctr_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IMPROVING if 7‑day ctr average >105% of 30‑day; DECLINING if <95%; else STABLE
      - name: spend_yoy_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the same day 365 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs 30 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: spend_wow_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs 7 days earlier when the prior value>0; otherwise NULL
      - name: ctr_z_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z‑score of daily_ctr vs its 30‑day mean and standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation≤0
      - name: cpc_z_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute z‑score of daily_cpc vs its 30‑day mean and standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation≤0
      - name: ctr_dow_deviation_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute percent deviation from the day‑of‑week average ctr; NULL when the baseline is zero
      - name: spend_dow_deviation_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute percent deviation from the day‑of‑week average spend; NULL when the baseline is zero
      - name: dow_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_ctr per platform and day_of_week over the 18‑month input window
      - name: dow_avg_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_spend per platform and day_of_week over the 18‑month input window
      - name: monthly_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_ctr per platform and month_of_year over the 18‑month input window
      - name: monthly_avg_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_spend per platform and month_of_year over the 18‑month input window
      - name: spend_seasonal_factor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of daily_spend to monthly_avg_spend; NULL when the monthly average is zero
      - name: ctr_seasonal_factor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of daily_ctr to monthly_avg_ctr; NULL when the monthly average is zero
      - name: spend_30d_trend_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: '30‑day outlook: 30‑day average plus 30 times the 90‑day spend trend slope'
      - name: ctr_30d_trend_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: '30‑day outlook: 30‑day average plus 30 times the 90‑day ctr trend slope'
      - name: spend_lower_confidence
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Lower bound: 30‑day average minus two 30‑day standard deviations'
      - name: spend_upper_confidence
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Upper bound: 30‑day average plus two 30‑day standard deviations'
      - name: market_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Market classification: ANOMALOUS, VOLATILE, OPTIMIZING, SCALING, or NORMAL based on z‑scores, WoW change, and momentum'
      - name: requires_investigation
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ctr_z_score>3 or cpc_z_score>3 or absolute WoW spend change>200%; otherwise false
      - name: optimization_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action hint: OPTIMIZE_TARGETING, OPTIMIZE_BIDDING, SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDED, SCALE_OPPORTUNITY, or MONITOR'
      - name: analysis_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the analysis row was generated (current time at query runtime)

hits.line_text: business_logic: '- Ingest four ad sources, align fields, and union: - google_ads: cost comes from spend; conversions and conversion value as provided. - amazon_ads: conversions come from purchases_30_d; revenue uses sales_30_d; no conversion value. - facebook_ads: date is converted to date_day; ad_id is treated as the campaign identifier; conversions set to 0; clicks use inline_link_clicks; cost from spend. - linkedin_ads: day is converted to date_day; ensure impressions and cost are numeric; conversions use conversion_value_in_local_currency as an integer count; exclude rows with negative cost_in_usd. - Keep only records with date_day in the last 18 months, then aggregate by date_day and platform: - Sums: impressions, clicks, cost (spend), conversions, revenue (conversion value when present, else 30‑day revenue; missing treated as 0). - KPIs: CTR = 100×(clicks/impressions) rounded to 4 decimals when impressions>0, else 0; CPC = spend/clicks rounded to 2 decimals when clicks>0, else 0; CPA = spend/conversions rounded to 2 decimals when conversions>0, else 0; ROAS = revenue/spend rounded to 4 decimals when both >0, else 0. - Campaign indicators: active_campaigns = distinct campaigns; campaigns_with_clicks = distinct campaigns with clicks>0; market_active_day = 1 when total impressions>0, else 0. - Derive calendar features: day_of_week (0=Sun..6=Sat), week_of_year, month_of_year, quarter_of_year, day_type (WEEKEND when Sun/Sat else WEEKDAY), month_period (EARLY/MID/LATE/END by day of month), and seasonal_period using explicit US seasonal date rules. For trend math, compute days since 1970‑01‑01 as a whole‑day index. - Rolling metrics are computed per platform ordered by date_day and include the current day; if fewer than N days exist, use the available days: - Moving averages: last 7 days (spend, ctr, cpc), last 30 days (spend, ctr, cpc), and last 90 days (spend). - spend_ewma is approximated as the same 7‑day simple average of spend. - Volatility: sample standard deviation over the last 30 days for ctr and cpc. - Trend and seasonality: - 90‑day rolling linear trend slopes for spend and ctr using the day index (days since epoch). - Prior‑period references: values from 365, 30, and 7 days earlier for YoY, MoM, and WoW comparisons. - Baselines: average ctr and spend by day_of_week, and by month_of_year, over the available 18‑month input window. - Anomalies and momentum: - Percent change vs prior periods is computed when the prior value is >0; otherwise NULL. - z‑scores are absolute deviations from the 30‑day mean scaled by the 30‑day standard deviation; 0 when the standard deviation is not positive. - Day‑of‑week deviation is the absolute percent difference from the day‑of‑week average; NULL when the baseline is zero. - Momentum: spend is ACCELERATING when the 7‑day average exceeds 110% of the 30‑day average, DECELERATING when below 90%, else STABLE; ctr is IMPROVING when the 7‑day average exceeds 105% of the 30‑day average, DECLINING when below 95%, else STABLE. - Trend direction from the 90‑day spend slope: STRONG_UPTREND (>0.1), MILD_UPTREND (>0 to 0.1], STRONG_DOWNTREND (<-0.1), MILD_DOWNTREND (<0 to -0.1], else SIDEWAYS. - Forecasting and confidence: - 30‑day trend forecasts add 30 times the 90‑day slope to the 30‑day average (for spend and ctr). - Seasonal factors are ratios of the daily values to the corresponding monthly averages; NULL when the monthly average is zero. - Confidence bounds are the 30‑day average minus/plus two 30‑day standard deviations. - Market signals and actions: - market_state precedence: ANOMALOUS when ctr_z_score>2 or cpc_z_score>2; else VOLATILE when WoW spend change is >50% or <‑50%; else OPTIMIZING when ctr momentum is IMPROVING and spend momentum is STABLE; else SCALING when spend momentum is ACCELERATING and ctr momentum is STABLE; else NORMAL. - requires_investigation is true when ctr_z_score>3, or cpc_z_score>3, or absolute WoW spend change exceeds 200%; otherwise false. - optimization_recommendation: OPTIMIZE_TARGETING when ctr is DECLINING and spend is ACCELERATING; OPTIMIZE_BIDDING when cpc_z_score>2 and ctr momentum is STABLE; SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDED when spend seasonal factor>1.2 and ctr seasonal factor<0.8; SCALE_OPPORTUNITY when market_state is SCALING; otherwise MONITOR. - Finalize by keeping only the last 12 months, ordering by platform ascending and date_day descending, and stamping analysis_generated_at with the current timestamp.'
