- name: int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics
      description: Unified daily campaign metrics across platforms with standardized KPIs, performance tiers, rolling 365‑day filter, and data quality screening
      grain: One row per platform, campaign_id, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report
      - staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report
      - raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data
      business_logic: 'Combine four platform feeds into a standardized base and apply filters per source: - Amazon Ads (staging.stg_amazon_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform=''amazon_ads''; campaign_type from campaign_bidding_strategy; daily_budget from campaign_budget_amount; currency from campaign_budget_currency_code; cost from source; revenue_7d from sales_7_d; revenue_30d from sales_30_d; conversions from purchases_30_d; conversion_type=''PRODUCT_SALES''; CTR, CPC, ROAS from source; source_updated_at from _dbt_loaded_at. - Keep rows where clicks, impressions, and cost are all non‑negative. - Google Ads (staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_report): - Map fields: platform=''google_ads''; campaign_type from ad_network_type with default ''SEARCH''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; cost from spend; revenue_7d and revenue_30d both from conversions_value; conversions from conversions; conversion_type=''ONLINE_CONVERSION''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS as revenue_7d ÷ cost when both are positive, else 0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where clicks, impressions, and spend are all non‑negative. - Facebook Ads (staging.stg_facebook_ads__ad_report): - Map fields: platform=''facebook_ads''; campaign_id from ad_id; campaign_type=''FACEBOOK_FEED''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; clicks from inline_link_clicks defaulting to 0; impressions defaulting to 0; cost from spend defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions=0; conversion_type=''ENGAGEMENT''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 when clicks=0; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where spend and impressions are non‑negative. - LinkedIn Ads (raw.linkedin_ad_analytics_by_campaign_data): - Map fields: platform=''linkedin_ads''; date_day from day; campaign_type=''LINKEDIN_SPONSORED''; daily_budget NULL; currency=''USD''; clicks defaulting to 0; impressions cast to integer and defaulting to 0; cost cast to decimal and defaulting to 0; revenue_7d=0; revenue_30d=0; conversions from conversion_value_in_local_currency cast to integer and defaulting to 0; conversion_type=''LEAD_GENERATION''. - KPIs: CTR as percentage (clicks ÷ impressions), rounded to 4 decimals and set to 0 when impressions=0; CPC as cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals and set to 0 unless both clicks and cost are positive; ROAS=0. - Set source_updated_at to the execution timestamp; keep rows where cost_in_usd is non‑negative. Enhance with performance metrics (computed on the full base before final filters): - ctr_performance_tier: platform‑specific thresholds on CTR (percent): - amazon_ads: HIGH when ≥0.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.2; else LOW. - google_ads: HIGH when ≥2.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.8; else LOW. - facebook_ads: HIGH when ≥1.5; MEDIUM when ≥0.9; else LOW. - others: HIGH when ≥1.0; MEDIUM when ≥0.5; else LOW. - cost_efficiency_tier: VERY_EFFICIENT when CPC≤0.5; EFFICIENT when ≤1.5; MODERATE when ≤3.0; EXPENSIVE when ≤5.0; else VERY_EXPENSIVE. - roas_performance_tier: for amazon_ads and google_ads, classify ROAS as EXCELLENT when ≥4.0; GOOD when ≥2.0; BREAK_EVEN when ≥1.0; LOSS_MAKING when >0; else NO_REVENUE; other platforms NOT_APPLICABLE. - campaign_age_days: days since the earliest observed date_day for the platform and campaign_id in the full base (not limited to the 365‑day window). - volume_tier: HIGH_VOLUME when impressions≥10,000; MEDIUM_VOLUME when ≥1,000; LOW_VOLUME when ≥100; else MINIMAL_VOLUME. Final selection and additional computations: - cost_per_mille (CPM): cost per 1,000 impressions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when impressions=0. - cost_per_conversion: cost ÷ conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; set to 0 when conversions=0. - lifecycle_stage from campaign_age_days: LAUNCH when ≤7; OPTIMIZATION when ≤30; MATURE when ≤90; else ESTABLISHED. - has_data_quality_issues: TRUE when clicks>impressions or cost<0 or CTR>100 or CPC>50; otherwise FALSE. - processed_at set to the execution timestamp. Apply final filters: - Keep rows where date_day is within the last 365 days relative to execution. - Keep rows where impressions>0. - Exclude rows flagged with has_data_quality_issues (output rows have has_data_quality_issues=FALSE). Notes: - Inputs are combined without deduplication; no ordering is enforced. - Rounding: CTR to 4 decimals (for computed platforms), CPC to 2 decimals, CPM to 2 decimals, cost_per_conversion to 2 decimals. - Units: CTR is a percentage; CPC/CPM/cost_per_conversion and cost are in the stated currency (USD for Google/Facebook/LinkedIn; Amazon uses its source currency); ROAS is a ratio. - CURRENT_DATE and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP are evaluated at query execution time.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ad platform identifier: ''amazon_ads'', ''google_ads'', ''facebook_ads'', or ''linkedin_ads'''
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source campaign identifier (Facebook uses ad_id as campaign_id)
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date; only rows within the rolling last 365 days relative to execution are kept
      - name: campaign_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform-specific campaign type (Amazon=bidding strategy, Google=ad_network_type default 'SEARCH', Facebook='FACEBOOK_FEED', LinkedIn='LINKEDIN_SPONSORED')
      - name: daily_budget
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Daily budget amount (Amazon only from campaign_budget_amount; NULL for other platforms; currency given by currency column)
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO currency code for monetary fields (USD for Google/Facebook/LinkedIn; Amazon from campaign_budget_currency_code)
      - name: conversion_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Conversion attribution type by platform: ''PRODUCT_SALES'', ''ONLINE_CONVERSION'', ''ENGAGEMENT'', or ''LEAD_GENERATION'''
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of impressions (non-negative in base; cast to integer on LinkedIn); final output enforces impressions>0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of clicks (defaults to 0 where applicable); must be ≤ impressions in final output due to data quality filtering
      - name: cost
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend amount (Amazon in source currency; Google/Facebook/LinkedIn in USD); non-negative in base and non-negative in final output
      - name: revenue_7d
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: 7-day revenue proxy (Amazon=sales_7_d, Google=conversions_value, others=0)
      - name: revenue_30d
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: 30-day revenue proxy (Amazon=sales_30_d, Google=conversions_value, others=0)
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(12,2)
        description: Conversion count/value (Amazon=purchases_30_d, Google=conversions, Facebook=0, LinkedIn from conversion_value_in_local_currency as integer)
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CTR as a percentage in [0,100] (Amazon from source; others as clicks ÷ impressions expressed as percent, rounded to 4 decimals; rows with CTR>100 are excluded)
      - name: cost_per_click
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CPC (Amazon from source; others as cost ÷ clicks rounded to 2 decimals with 0 when clicks≤0); rows with CPC>50 are excluded
      - name: return_on_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: ROAS ratio (Amazon from source; Google as revenue_7d ÷ cost with 0 when inputs are not positive; others=0)
      - name: cost_per_mille
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CPM as cost per 1,000 impressions rounded to 2 decimals; denominator is always >0 due to final filter
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion as cost ÷ conversions rounded to 2 decimals when conversions>0 else 0
      - name: ctr_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CTR performance classification by platform (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) using platform-specific percent thresholds
      - name: cost_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'CPC-based cost efficiency classification: VERY_EFFICIENT, EFFICIENT, MODERATE, EXPENSIVE, VERY_EXPENSIVE'
      - name: roas_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ROAS-based classification for Amazon/Google (EXCELLENT, GOOD, BREAK_EVEN, LOSS_MAKING, NO_REVENUE) else NOT_APPLICABLE
      - name: volume_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Impression volume classification: HIGH_VOLUME (≥10,000), MEDIUM_VOLUME (≥1,000), LOW_VOLUME (≥100), else MINIMAL_VOLUME'
      - name: campaign_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the earliest observed date_day for the platform+campaign_id in the base (pre 365‑day filter)
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage by campaign_age_days: LAUNCH (≤7), OPTIMIZATION (≤30), MATURE (≤90), else ESTABLISHED'
      - name: has_data_quality_issues
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if clicks>impressions or cost<0 or CTR>100 or CPC>50; final output only contains FALSE due to filtering
      - name: source_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Source freshness timestamp (Amazon=_dbt_loaded_at; Google/Facebook/LinkedIn set to the execution timestamp)
      - name: processed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Model processing timestamp set to the execution timestamp

Apply final filters: - Keep rows where date_day is within the last 365 days relative to execution. - Keep rows where impressions>0. - Exclude rows flagged with has_data_quality_issues (output rows have has_data_quality_issues=FALSE). Notes: - Inputs are combined without deduplication; no ordering is enforced. - Rounding: CTR to 4 decimals (for computed platforms), CPC to 2 decimals, CPM to 2 decimals, cost_per_conversion to 2 decimals. - Units: CTR is a percentage; CPC/CPM/cost_per_conversion and cost are in the stated currency (USD for Google/Facebook/LinkedIn; Amazon uses its source currency); ROAS is a ratio. - CURRENT_DATE and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP are evaluated at query execution time.'

      grain: One row per source row in staging.stg_amazon_ads__product_report
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_amazon_ads__product_report
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__product_report with no aggregation, filtering, or de-duplication. - Set platform to the constant ''amazon_ads''. - Identifiers: url_or_product_id is advertised_asin as a string; date_day is copied; campaign_id and ad_group_id are copied; account_id and ad_id are set to NULL. - Product attributes: product_sku is advertised_sku; product_asin is advertised_asin; landing_page_url, final_url, and display_url are NULL; url_type is the constant ''product''. - Performance metrics default to 0 when null: impressions, clicks; interactions is set to 0. - Cost defaults to 0 when null. - Conversions: conversions equals attributed_conversions_30_d (defaults to 0 when null); conversions_value equals attributed_sales_30_d (defaults to 0 when null); view_through_conversions is 0. - Amazon-specific metrics default to 0 when null: attributed_sales_14_d/30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d/30_d, attributed_units_ordered_14_d/30_d. - URL engagement metrics (bounce_rate, pages_per_session, avg_session_duration, landing_page_experience, mobile_friendly_click_rate) are NULL. - Calculated metrics: - click_through_rate: (clicks ÷ impressions) × 100, rounded to 4 decimals; if impressions = 0 then 0. - cost_per_click: cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; if clicks = 0 then 0. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: (cost ÷ impressions) × 1000, rounded to 2 decimals; if impressions = 0 then 0. - cost_per_conversion: cost ÷ attributed_conversions_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_conversions_30_d = 0 then 0. - return_on_ad_spend: attributed_sales_30_d ÷ cost, rounded to 4 decimals; if cost = 0 or attributed_sales_30_d = 0 then 0. - units_per_conversion: attributed_units_ordered_30_d ÷ attributed_conversions_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_conversions_30_d = 0 then 0. - avg_order_value: attributed_sales_30_d ÷ attributed_units_ordered_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_units_ordered_30_d = 0 then 0. - Carry through _dbt_loaded_at from the source unchanged.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_amazon_ads__product_report with no aggregation, filtering, or de-duplication. - Set platform to the constant ''amazon_ads''. - Identifiers: url_or_product_id is advertised_asin as a string; date_day is copied; campaign_id and ad_group_id are copied; account_id and ad_id are set to NULL. - Product attributes: product_sku is advertised_sku; product_asin is advertised_asin; landing_page_url, final_url, and display_url are NULL; url_type is the constant ''product''. - Performance metrics default to 0 when null: impressions, clicks; interactions is set to 0. - Cost defaults to 0 when null. - Conversions: conversions equals attributed_conversions_30_d (defaults to 0 when null); conversions_value equals attributed_sales_30_d (defaults to 0 when null); view_through_conversions is 0. - Amazon-specific metrics default to 0 when null: attributed_sales_14_d/30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d/30_d, attributed_units_ordered_14_d/30_d. - URL engagement metrics (bounce_rate, pages_per_session, avg_session_duration, landing_page_experience, mobile_friendly_click_rate) are NULL. - Calculated metrics: - click_through_rate: (clicks ÷ impressions) × 100, rounded to 4 decimals; if impressions = 0 then 0. - cost_per_click: cost ÷ clicks, rounded to 2 decimals; if clicks = 0 then 0. - cost_per_thousand_impressions: (cost ÷ impressions) × 1000, rounded to 2 decimals; if impressions = 0 then 0. - cost_per_conversion: cost ÷ attributed_conversions_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_conversions_30_d = 0 then 0. - return_on_ad_spend: attributed_sales_30_d ÷ cost, rounded to 4 decimals; if cost = 0 or attributed_sales_30_d = 0 then 0. - units_per_conversion: attributed_units_ordered_30_d ÷ attributed_conversions_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_conversions_30_d = 0 then 0. - avg_order_value: attributed_sales_30_d ÷ attributed_units_ordered_30_d, rounded to 2 decimals; if attributed_units_ordered_30_d = 0 then 0. - Carry through _dbt_loaded_at from the source unchanged.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__account_report
      description: Business-friendly account-level ad performance across platforms with pass-through metrics and renames; rows with platform='placeholder' are excluded
      grain: Rows at (platform, account_id, report_date, ad_network_type, device_type) per source row (no de-duplication)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__account_report
      business_logic: '- Read from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__account_report. - Select and rename: date_day→report_date; device→device_type; cost→spend; click_through_rate→ctr_percent; cost_per_click→cpc; cost_per_thousand_impressions→cpm; cost_per_conversion→cpa; return_on_ad_spend→roas; _dbt_loaded_at→data_last_updated. - Compute mart_created_at as CURRENT_TIMESTAMP at model execution time (timezone-aware). - Filter: platform != ''placeholder'' (rows with NULL platform are excluded by this predicate). - Preserve all other values exactly as in source; no aggregation, rounding changes, unit conversion, or de-duplication. - Output ordered by platform, account_id, report_date DESC.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform identifier; non-NULL and not 'placeholder' due to filter; pass-through from source
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising account identifier; pass-through from source; NULLs preserved
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date sourced from date_day; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Ad network type code; pass-through from source; NULLs preserved
      - name: device_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Device type code sourced from device; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Impressions from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Clicks from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: interactions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Interactions from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Advertising cost sourced from cost; two-decimal precision as provided; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Conversions from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Conversion value in source currency; two-decimal precision; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: View-through conversions from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_view_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active View impressions; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_view_measurable_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active View measurable impressions; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_view_measurable_cost
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active View measurable cost (integer amount as provided); pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_view_measurability
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active View measurability metric as provided; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_view_viewability
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active View viewability metric as provided; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: ctr_percent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate sourced from click_through_rate; pass-through; NULLs preserved; not recomputed
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per click sourced from cost_per_click; pass-through; NULLs preserved; not recomputed
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per thousand impressions sourced from cost_per_thousand_impressions; pass-through; NULLs preserved; not recomputed
      - name: cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion sourced from cost_per_conversion; pass-through; NULLs preserved; not recomputed
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend sourced from return_on_ad_spend; pass-through; NULLs preserved; not recomputed
      - name: interaction_event_types
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Interaction event types value from source; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: data_last_updated
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: ETL load timestamp sourced from _dbt_loaded_at; timezone-aware; pass-through; NULLs preserved
      - name: mart_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Model execution timestamp from CURRENT_TIMESTAMP at build time; timezone-aware; varies per run

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__ad_report
      description: Unified ad-level performance across platforms; passthrough from intermediate with renames, placeholder filter, and timestamps
      grain: One row per platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id, report_date, ad_network_type, device_type
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__ad_report
      business_logic: 'Input: intermediate.int_ad_reporting__ad_report. Steps: - Exclude rows where platform equals ''placeholder''; preserve all other rows and duplicates. - Rename fields: date_day to report_date; device to device_type; cost to spend; attributed_sales_14_d to attributed_sales_14_day; attributed_sales_30_d to attributed_sales_30_day; attributed_conversions_14_d to attributed_conversions_14_day; attributed_conversions_30_d to attributed_conversions_30_day; click_through_rate to ctr_percent; cost_per_click to cpc; cost_per_thousand_impressions to cpm; cost_per_conversion to cpa; return_on_ad_spend to roas. - Set campaign_name, ad_group_name, ad_name, ad_type, and ad_status to NULL (not available in source). - Set data_last_updated from _dbt_loaded_at; set mart_created_at to the model run timestamp (same value for all rows in a run). - No joins or aggregations; all other fields are direct passthrough from the source; NULLs are preserved. - Sort output by platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id ascending and report_date descending; sorting does not change row content.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform identifier; direct passthrough from source after excluding 'placeholder'
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising account identifier; direct passthrough from source
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier; direct passthrough from source
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier; direct passthrough from source
      - name: ad_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad/creative identifier; direct passthrough from source
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metrics date (renamed from date_day); direct passthrough
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not populated in this model; always NULL to preserve schema
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not populated in this model; always NULL to preserve schema
      - name: ad_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not populated in this model; always NULL to preserve schema
      - name: ad_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not populated in this model; always NULL to preserve schema
      - name: ad_status
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Not populated in this model; always NULL to preserve schema
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Ad network/placement type; direct passthrough from source
      - name: device_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Device dimension (renamed from device); direct passthrough
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Number of impressions; direct passthrough from source
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Number of clicks; direct passthrough from source
      - name: interactions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Number of interactions; direct passthrough from source
      - name: spend

        description: Number of conversions; direct passthrough from source

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__campaign_report
      description: Business-friendly campaign-level advertising metrics across platforms; pass-through from intermediate with selected renames and placeholder filtering
      grain: One row per source record (conceptually per platform, account_id, campaign_id, report_date); duplicates from source are preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report
      business_logic: '- Source: read all rows from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__campaign_report. - Filter: remove rows where platform is the literal "placeholder". - Column mapping (no aggregation; values copied as-is; NULLs and duplicates preserved; original text casing/spacing preserved): - date_day -> report_date - device -> device_type - cost -> spend - attributed_sales_14_d -> attributed_sales_14_day - attributed_sales_30_d -> attributed_sales_30_day - attributed_conversions_14_d -> attributed_conversions_14_day - attributed_conversions_30_d -> attributed_conversions_30_day - click_through_rate -> ctr_percent - cost_per_click -> cpc - cost_per_thousand_impressions -> cpm - cost_per_conversion -> cpa - return_on_ad_spend -> roas - _dbt_loaded_at -> data_last_updated - mart_created_at: set to the current timestamp at model execution time. - All other selected fields are passed through unchanged. - Row ordering: sort by platform, account_id, campaign_id ascending and report_date descending.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising platform; rows with the literal 'placeholder' are excluded
      - name: account_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform account identifier
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date from source date_day
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Campaign name label as stored in the source (integer-coded)
      - name: ad_network_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Ad network type code
      - name: device_type
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Device type code from source device
      - name: impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Impression count
      - name: clicks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Click count
      - name: interactions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Interaction count
      - name: spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Advertising spend mapped from source cost
      - name: conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Conversion count
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Monetary value of conversions
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: View-through conversions count
      - name: active_view_impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View impressions (Google Ads)
      - name: active_view_measurable_impressions
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurable impressions (Google Ads)
      - name: active_view_measurable_cost
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurable cost (Google Ads)
      - name: active_view_measurability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View measurability metric (Google Ads)
      - name: active_view_viewability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Active View viewability metric (Google Ads)
      - name: attributed_sales_14_day
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Amazon Ads attributed sales over 14 days, from attributed_sales_14_d
      - name: attributed_sales_30_day
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Amazon Ads attributed sales over 30 days, from attributed_sales_30_d
      - name: attributed_conversions_14_day
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Amazon Ads attributed conversions over 14 days, from attributed_conversions_14_d
      - name: attributed_conversions_30_day
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Amazon Ads attributed conversions over 30 days, from attributed_conversions_30_d
      - name: ctr_percent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-through rate from source click_through_rate
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per click from source cost_per_click
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per thousand impressions from source cost_per_thousand_impressions
      - name: cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion from source cost_per_conversion
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend from source return_on_ad_spend
      - name: interaction_event_types
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Interaction event types count or code
      - name: data_last_updated
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last load timestamp from _dbt_loaded_at
      - name: mart_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Model execution timestamp set at creation time

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics mart filtered to the last 24 months with KPIs, segments, health scores, and benchmarking; one row per customer
      grain: One row per customer_identifier
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis
      business_logic: '- Source: intermediate.int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis (fields used: customer_identifier, acquisition_cohort, first_interaction_date, last_interaction_date, customer_lifespan_days, days_since_acquisition, customer_value_tier, engagement_level, conversion_behavior, recency_status, active_days, platforms_used, campaigns_interacted, total_impressions, total_clicks, total_conversions, total_revenue, total_cost_attributed, click_to_conversion_rate, impression_to_click_rate, average_order_value, customer_roas, total_first_touch_revenue, total_last_touch_revenue, total_linear_attributed_revenue, total_time_decay_attributed_revenue, cohort_size, retained_month_1, retained_month_2, retained_month_3, retention_rate_month_1, retention_rate_month_2, retention_rate_month_3, analysis_generated_at). - Filter window: keep rows where first_interaction_date is within the last 24 months relative to the current date; rows with NULL first_interaction_date are excluded. - Pass-through selections: project all listed source fields unchanged (types and precision preserved). - RFM scores (deterministic mappings): - recency_score (from recency_status): RECENT→5; MODERATE→4; DORMANT→2; ELSE→1. - frequency_score (from total_conversions): >=10→5; >=5→4; >=2→3; =1→2; ELSE→1. Comparisons are inclusive where stated. - monetary_score (from total_revenue): >=1000→5; >=500→4; >=100→3; >=50→2; >0→1; ELSE→0. Comparisons are inclusive where stated. - rfm_segment (evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins): - RECENT and total_conversions>=5 and total_revenue>=1000 → CHAMPIONS - (RECENT or MODERATE) and total_conversions>=3 and total_revenue>=500 → LOYAL_CUSTOMERS - RECENT and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue>=100 → POTENTIAL_LOYALISTS - RECENT and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue<=100 → NEW_CUSTOMERS - MODERATE and total_conversions>=3 and total_revenue<=200 → PROMISING - (DORMANT or INACTIVE) and total_conversions>=3 and total_revenue>=500 → CUSTOMERS_NEEDING_ATTENTION - (DORMANT or INACTIVE) and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue>=200 → ABOUT_TO_SLEEP - (DORMANT or INACTIVE) and total_conversions>=3 and total_revenue<=200 → AT_RISK - INACTIVE and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue<=100 → LOST - ELSE → OTHERS - customer_health_score (0–100 integer): sum four components, then bound the result to 0–100: - recency_status: RECENT→25; ELSE→0 - engagement_level: HIGHLY_ENGAGED→25; MODERATELY_ENGAGED→15; LIGHTLY_ENGAGED→5; ELSE→0 - conversion_behavior: FREQUENT_CONVERTER→25; REPEAT_CONVERTER→15; SINGLE_CONVERTER→5; ELSE→0 - customer_roas: >=3.0→25; >=2.0→15; >=1.0→10; >0→5; ELSE→0 - churn_risk_level (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): - recency_status=INACTIVE → HIGH_CHURN_RISK - recency_status=DORMANT and engagement_level=SINGLE_INTERACTION → MEDIUM_CHURN_RISK - customer_roas < 0.5 → UNPROFITABLE_RISK - ELSE → LOW_RISK - clv_potential (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): - total_revenue>=1000 and customer_roas>=2.0 → HIGH_POTENTIAL - total_revenue>=500 or customer_roas>=1.5 → MEDIUM_POTENTIAL - total_revenue>=100 → LOW_POTENTIAL - ELSE → MINIMAL_POTENTIAL - marketing_recommendation (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): - RECENT and total_conversions>=5 and total_revenue>=1000 → "VIP treatment, exclusive offers, loyalty program" - (RECENT or MODERATE) and total_conversions>=3 → "Retention campaigns, upsell opportunities" - RECENT and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue>=100 → "Frequency building campaigns, personalized recommendations" - RECENT and total_conversions<=2 and total_revenue<=100 → "Onboarding campaigns, educational content" - (DORMANT or INACTIVE) and total_conversions>=3 → "Re-engagement campaigns, win-back offers" - INACTIVE → "Last-chance campaigns, deep discounts" - ELSE → "Standard marketing campaigns" - investment_priority (evaluated in listed order; first match wins; uses computed churn_risk_level with customer_value_tier and customer_health_score): - customer_value_tier=HIGH_VALUE and churn_risk_level=LOW_RISK → RETAIN_EXPAND - customer_value_tier in (MEDIUM_VALUE, LOW_VALUE) and customer_health_score>=60 → DEVELOP_NURTURE - churn_risk_level in (HIGH_CHURN_RISK, MEDIUM_CHURN_RISK) → URGENT_INTERVENTION - churn_risk_level=UNPROFITABLE_RISK → WIN_BACK_OR_IGNORE - ELSE → STANDARD_TREATMENT - Benchmarking percentiles (computed over the filtered dataset): - clv_percentile: percentile rank across all rows sorted by total_revenue ascending; NULLs sort after non-NULLs; ties share the same percentile; values range from 0 to 1. - health_score_percentile: percentile rank across all rows sorted by customer_health_score ascending; NULLs sort after non-NULLs; ties share the same percentile; values range from 0 to 1. - cohort_clv_percentile: percentile rank within each acquisition_cohort sorted by total_revenue ascending; NULLs sort after non-NULLs; ties share the same percentile; values range from 0 to 1. - Analysis metadata: - analysis_generated_at: passed through from source - report_generated_at: set at runtime to the current timestamp in the session time zone - Final ordering: rows are sorted by investment_priority ascending, then total_revenue descending, then customer_health_score descending; rows with identical sort keys have undefined relative order.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_identifier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique customer identifier; table grain and grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: acquisition_cohort
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date representing the customer’s acquisition cohort from source
      - name: first_interaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: First recorded interaction date; used to apply the 24-month filter
      - name: last_interaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent interaction date from source
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days between the first and last interaction from source
      - name: days_since_acquisition
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days from acquisition_cohort to the current date from source
      - name: customer_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Value tier classification from source (e.g., HIGH_VALUE, MEDIUM_VALUE, LOW_VALUE)
      - name: engagement_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Engagement level from source (e.g., HIGHLY_ENGAGED, MODERATELY_ENGAGED, LIGHTLY_ENGAGED, SINGLE_INTERACTION)
      - name: conversion_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Conversion behavior from source (e.g., FREQUENT_CONVERTER, REPEAT_CONVERTER, SINGLE_CONVERTER)
      - name: recency_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recency label from source (e.g., RECENT, MODERATE, DORMANT, INACTIVE)
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of days with activity from source
      - name: platforms_used
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct platforms used from source
      - name: campaigns_interacted
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct campaigns interacted with from source
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impression count from source
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total click count from source
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total conversions from source; used in frequency and segment rules
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total revenue from source; used in monetary and segment rules
      - name: total_cost_attributed
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total attributed cost from source
      - name: click_to_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Precomputed click-to-conversion rate from source without additional rounding
      - name: impression_to_click_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Precomputed impression-to-click rate from source without additional rounding
      - name: average_order_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Precomputed average order value from source without additional rounding
      - name: customer_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Precomputed return on ad spend from source; used in health, churn, and CLV potential rules
      - name: total_first_touch_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Revenue attributed to first touch from source
      - name: total_last_touch_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Revenue attributed to last touch from source
      - name: total_linear_attributed_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Revenue attributed via a linear model from source
      - name: total_time_decay_attributed_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Revenue attributed via a time-decay model from source
      - name: cohort_size
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Size of the acquisition cohort from source
      - name: retained_month_1
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Count retained at month 1 from source
      - name: retained_month_2
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Count retained at month 2 from source
      - name: retained_month_3
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Count retained at month 3 from source
      - name: retention_rate_month_1
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Retention rate at month 1 from source (percentage with one decimal)
      - name: retention_rate_month_2
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Retention rate at month 2 from source (percentage with one decimal)
      - name: retention_rate_month_3
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Retention rate at month 3 from source (percentage with one decimal)
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM recency score derived from recency_status using the specified mapping
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM frequency score derived from total_conversions using threshold-based mapping
      - name: monetary_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM monetary score derived from total_revenue using threshold-based mapping
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM segment label determined by ordered rules; first matching rule applies
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite 0–100 score (sum of four components) bounded to the 0–100 range
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Churn risk category from recency_status, engagement_level, and customer_roas (ordered evaluation)
      - name: clv_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CLV potential category from total_revenue and customer_roas thresholds (ordered evaluation)
      - name: marketing_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommended marketing action based on recency_status, total_conversions, and total_revenue (ordered evaluation)
      - name: investment_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment priority derived from customer_value_tier, churn_risk_level, and customer_health_score (ordered evaluation)
      - name: clv_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank across all customers by total_revenue ascending; NULLs last; ties share percentile; value in [0,1]
      - name: health_score_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank across all customers by customer_health_score ascending; NULLs last; ties share percentile; value in [0,1]
      - name: cohort_clv_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank within acquisition_cohort by total_revenue ascending; NULLs last; ties share percentile; value in [0,1]
      - name: analysis_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Analysis timestamp passed through from source
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Runtime timestamp set to the current session time at query execution

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__executive_dashboard
      description: Executive monthly ad performance, customer, and geographic KPIs with strategic insights (one row per month)
      grain: One row per reporting_month
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__customer_journey_analysis
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__geo_channel_performance
      business_logic: '- Executive KPIs (last 12 months): For each platform and month, compute monthly investment (sum of spend), average daily spend, active days, totals for impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue, average CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS (CTR and ROAS rounded to 4 decimals; CPC and CPA to 2), and volatility as the standard deviation of daily CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2). Growth and anomaly placeholders are set to zero. - Customer insights (last 12 months): For each acquisition cohort month, compute new customers (distinct count), cohort revenue (sum), average customer value and lifespan, counts of high-value, highly engaged, and frequent converters, average retention for months 1–3, average customer ROAS and order value, average platforms used per customer, and count of multi-platform customers (used more than one platform). - Geographic performance (last 6 months): For each month and region, compute active countries (distinct count), regional investment (sum), average market CTR and CPC, spend in high-opportunity markets (sum) and count of such markets, mature market ratio (share of markets classified as mature), average market share and performance percentiles, and average multi-channel adoption. - Unified performance (last 12 months): For each month, compute active platforms (distinct count), monthly totals for impressions/clicks/spend/conversions/revenue, blended averages for CTR/CPC/ROAS (rounded as above), variance across platforms for CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2), designate platform leaders (CTR leader is google_ads; efficiency and ROAS leaders are amazon_ads), and campaign metrics (distinct active campaigns, average campaign age, counts of new vs established campaigns). - Strategic insights by month: - Investment efficiency grade from overall ROAS thresholds (≥3.0, ≥2.0, ≥1.0, else). - Month-over-month growth rate as percent change in monthly spend versus the prior month, rounded to 2, and set to NULL if no prior month exists. - Portfolio diversification based on active platforms and CTR variance. - Expansion mode based on the ratio of new to established campaigns. - Performance consistency based on CTR and CPC variance thresholds. - Carry forward monthly totals, blended metrics, counts, and platform leaders. - Final output: Start from strategic insights; left join platform-level KPIs by month; left join cohort-level customer insights by cohort month; left join regional geographic performance by month; filter to the last 6 reporting months; group by month and the exposed categorical fields. - Aggregate per reporting_month: customer and geographic metrics are averaged or summed across joined rows; leader platform KPIs are taken from the platform that matches the designated leader; anomaly days use the maximum; performance volatility uses the average; platform growth uses the average; scaling and optimizing days use sums. - Recommendations and strategies: - Executive recommendation based on efficiency grade, consistency, expansion status, growth rate, and overall ROAS (with a default fallback). - Allocation strategy prioritizes when efficiency and ROAS leaders align; else considers low overall ROAS; else considers high average spend in high-opportunity markets; else defaults. Comparisons against aggregated values treat NULLs as not satisfying thresholds. - Customer strategy insight evaluates retention, high-value customer mix (with zero-division protection), and cross-platform engagement, with a default fallback. - Data quality and metadata: platforms_with_data is the count of platforms present in the platform KPI join for the month (0 when none); analysis_period_start and analysis_period_end both equal the reporting_month; dashboard_generated_at is the current timestamp; results are ordered by reporting_month descending.'
      columns:
      - name: reporting_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month bucket for all metrics; one output row per month; not null
      - name: reporting_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year derived from reporting_month; not null
      - name: reporting_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter (1–4) derived from reporting_month; not null
      - name: monthly_ad_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total monthly spend across platforms; may be NULL if upstream spend is absent
      - name: monthly_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total monthly 30-day revenue across platforms with two-decimal scale; may be NULL
      - name: overall_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended ROAS across platforms rounded to 4 decimals; may be NULL
      - name: overall_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended CTR across platforms rounded to 4 decimals on a 0–1 scale; may be NULL
      - name: overall_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended CPC across platforms rounded to 2 decimals; may be NULL
      - name: investment_efficiency_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Efficiency grade derived from overall ROAS thresholds; not null
      - name: month_over_month_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in monthly_ad_spend versus prior month rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when no prior month
      - name: portfolio_diversification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Diversification score based on active platforms and CTR variance; not null
      - name: expansion_mode
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Expansion status based on the share of new versus established campaigns; not null
      - name: performance_consistency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Consistency score based on CTR and CPC variance thresholds; not null
      - name: platforms_in_use
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of active platforms in the month; not null
      - name: total_active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct active campaigns in the month; not null
      - name: performance_leader_ctr
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform designated as CTR leader (constant google_ads); not null
      - name: efficiency_leader
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform designated as CPC efficiency leader (constant amazon_ads); not null
      - name: revenue_leader
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform designated as ROAS leader (constant amazon_ads); not null
      - name: monthly_avg_customer_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average customer value for cohorts in the month rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no cohort data
      - name: monthly_new_customers
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: New customers acquired in the cohort month; NULL if no cohort data
      - name: avg_customer_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average month-1 retention rate rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no cohort data
      - name: high_value_customers_acquired
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: High-value customers acquired in the cohort month; NULL if no cohort data
      - name: avg_platforms_per_customer
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average platforms used per customer rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if no cohort data
      - name: avg_countries_active
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average active countries across regions rounded to a whole number; NULL if no geo data
      - name: high_opportunity_spend_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of spend in high-opportunity markets rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when regional investment is zero or absent
      - name: mature_markets_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of markets classified as mature rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if no geo data
      - name: avg_market_position_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average market share position percentile (0–100) rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if no geo data
      - name: top_platform_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS for the revenue leader platform in the month; NULL if no matching platform data
      - name: top_platform_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR for the CTR leader platform in the month; NULL if no matching platform data
      - name: top_platform_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPC for the efficiency leader platform in the month; NULL if no matching platform data
      - name: max_platform_anomaly_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Maximum anomaly days across platforms for the month; NULL if no platform data
      - name: avg_performance_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR volatility across platforms rounded to 4 decimals; NULL if no platform data
      - name: avg_platform_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average platform-level month-over-month growth rate rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no platform data
      - name: total_scaling_days
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total platform-level scaling days in the month; NULL if no platform data
      - name: total_optimizing_days
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total platform-level optimizing days in the month; NULL if no platform data
      - name: executive_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation based on efficiency grade, consistency, expansion, growth rate, and ROAS; not null
      - name: allocation_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Allocation guidance based on leader alignment, overall ROAS, and average high-opportunity spend; not null
      - name: customer_strategy_insight
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer strategy guidance based on retention, high-value mix, and cross-platform engagement; not null
      - name: platforms_with_data
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of platforms present in the platform KPI join for the month; returns 0 when none; not null
      - name: analysis_period_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest reporting_month in the group (equals reporting_month); not null
      - name: analysis_period_end
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest reporting_month in the group (equals reporting_month); not null
      - name: dashboard_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the dashboard was generated; not null

hits.line_text: business_logic: '- Executive KPIs (last 12 months): For each platform and month, compute monthly investment (sum of spend), average daily spend, active days, totals for impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue, average CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS (CTR and ROAS rounded to 4 decimals; CPC and CPA to 2), and volatility as the standard deviation of daily CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2). Growth and anomaly placeholders are set to zero. - Customer insights (last 12 months): For each acquisition cohort month, compute new customers (distinct count), cohort revenue (sum), average customer value and lifespan, counts of high-value, highly engaged, and frequent converters, average retention for months 1–3, average customer ROAS and order value, average platforms used per customer, and count of multi-platform customers (used more than one platform). - Geographic performance (last 6 months): For each month and region, compute active countries (distinct count), regional investment (sum), average market CTR and CPC, spend in high-opportunity markets (sum) and count of such markets, mature market ratio (share of markets classified as mature), average market share and performance percentiles, and average multi-channel adoption. - Unified performance (last 12 months): For each month, compute active platforms (distinct count), monthly totals for impressions/clicks/spend/conversions/revenue, blended averages for CTR/CPC/ROAS (rounded as above), variance across platforms for CTR (rounded to 4) and CPC (rounded to 2), designate platform leaders (CTR leader is google_ads; efficiency and ROAS leaders are amazon_ads), and campaign metrics (distinct active campaigns, average campaign age, counts of new vs established campaigns). - Strategic insights by month: - Investment efficiency grade from overall ROAS thresholds (≥3.0, ≥2.0, ≥1.0, else). - Month-over-month growth rate as percent change in monthly spend versus the prior month, rounded to 2, and set to NULL if no prior month exists. - Portfolio diversification based on active platforms and CTR variance. - Expansion mode based on the ratio of new to established campaigns. - Performance consistency based on CTR and CPC variance thresholds. - Carry forward monthly totals, blended metrics, counts, and platform leaders. - Final output: Start from strategic insights; left join platform-level KPIs by month; left join cohort-level customer insights by cohort month; left join regional geographic performance by month; filter to the last 6 reporting months; group by month and the exposed categorical fields. - Aggregate per reporting_month: customer and geographic metrics are averaged or summed across joined rows; leader platform KPIs are taken from the platform that matches the designated leader; anomaly days use the maximum; performance volatility uses the average; platform growth uses the average; scaling and optimizing days use sums. - Recommendations and strategies: - Executive recommendation based on efficiency grade, consistency, expansion status, growth rate, and overall ROAS (with a default fallback). - Allocation strategy prioritizes when efficiency and ROAS leaders align; else considers low overall ROAS; else considers high average spend in high-opportunity markets; else defaults. Comparisons against aggregated values treat NULLs as not satisfying thresholds. - Customer strategy insight evaluates retention, high-value customer mix (with zero-division protection), and cross-platform engagement, with a default fallback. - Data quality and metadata: platforms_with_data is the count of platforms present in the platform KPI join for the month (0 when none); analysis_period_start and analysis_period_end both equal the reporting_month; dashboard_generated_at is the current timestamp; results are ordered by reporting_month descending.'

      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__keyword_report

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__market_opportunities
      description: Strategic market opportunities report derived from geo-channel performance with filters, KPIs, scoring, classifications, and recommendations
      grain: One row per filtered source record (typically per country_code, region, marketing_channel, performance_month)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__geo_channel_performance
      business_logic: 'Source and filter: - Read from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__geo_channel_performance. - Include only rows from the last 3 months (relative to the run date) and with total_spend > 0. Projections and renames: - Pass-through: country_code, region, marketing_channel, performance_month, active_advertisers, active_campaigns, campaigns_per_advertiser, active_days_in_month, total_impressions, total_clicks, total_conversions, total_revenue, market_cpm, market_cpa, cpc_variance, cpc_std_dev, market_opportunity_level, market_maturity, spend_share_percentile, performance_percentile, avg_daily_platform_diversity, multi_channel_advertisers, single_channel_advertisers, analysis_generated_at. - Rename: total_spend → current_monthly_spend; market_ctr → current_ctr; market_cpc → current_cpc; market_roas → current_roas; month_over_month_spend_growth → growth_rate. Deterministic derivations: - total_opportunity_score (INTEGER 0–100): Sum four components (each 0–25), then clamp the total to the 0–100 range: • Market size from total_spend: >=100000→25, >=50000→20, >=25000→15, >=10000→10, >=5000→5, else 0. • Growth from growth_rate: >=20→25, >=10→20, >=5→15, >=0→10, >=-10→5, else 0. • Performance from current_roas: >=3.0→25, >=2.5→20, >=2.0→15, >=1.5→10, >=1.0→5, else 0. • Competition from cpc_variance: <=0.1→25, <=0.3→20, <=0.5→15, <=0.8→10, <=1.2→5, else 0. Null comparisons evaluate false and add 0; the final score is always populated. - opportunity_tier: • If total_spend >= 50000 AND current_roas >= 2.5 AND growth_rate >= 10 → ''TIER_1_OPPORTUNITY''. • Else if total_spend >= 25000 AND current_roas >= 2.0 AND growth_rate >= 5 → ''TIER_2_OPPORTUNITY''. • Else if total_spend >= 10000 AND current_roas >= 1.5 → ''TIER_3_OPPORTUNITY''. • Else if total_spend >= 5000 → ''MONITOR''. • Else ''DEPRIORITIZE''. Nulls in comparisons fall through to lower tiers. - investment_strategy: • current_roas >= 2.5 AND growth_rate >= 10 → ''SCALE_AGGRESSIVELY''. • current_roas >= 2.0 AND (growth_rate >= 5 OR market_maturity = ''EMERGING'') → ''SCALE_MODERATELY''. • current_roas >= 1.5 AND cpc_variance <= 0.5 → ''OPTIMIZE_AND_GROW''. • current_roas >= 1.0 → ''TEST_AND_LEARN''. • Else ''OPTIMIZE_OR_EXIT''. - market_risk_level: • cpc_variance > 1.0 AND cpc_std_dev > 2.0 → ''HIGH_RISK''. • cpc_variance > 0.5 OR cpc_std_dev > 1.0 → ''MEDIUM_RISK''. • Else ''LOW_RISK''. - budget_recommendation: • current_roas >= 2.5 AND growth_rate >= 10 → ''INCREASE_BUDGET_50_PERCENT''. • current_roas >= 2.0 AND performance_percentile >= 0.7 → ''INCREASE_BUDGET_25_PERCENT''. • current_roas >= 1.5 AND spend_share_percentile <= 0.5 → ''INCREASE_BUDGET_15_PERCENT''. • current_roas < 1.0 → ''DECREASE_BUDGET_25_PERCENT''. • market_opportunity_level = ''OPTIMIZATION_NEEDED'' → ''DECREASE_BUDGET_30_PERCENT''. • Else ''MAINTAIN_CURRENT_BUDGET''. - expected_incremental_revenue (DOUBLE): • current_roas >= 2.5 → total_spend * 0.25 * current_roas. • current_roas >= 2.0 → total_spend * 0.15 * current_roas. • current_roas >= 1.5 → total_spend * 0.10 * current_roas. • Else 0. Uses the same currency/unit as total_spend; no rounding. - strategic_action_plan (VARCHAR): • If opportunity_tier = ''TIER_1_OPPORTUNITY'' AND market_risk_level = ''LOW_RISK'' → "PRIORITY: Scale investment in {marketing_channel} for {country_code}. Expected high returns with low risk." • Else if opportunity_tier = ''TIER_1_OPPORTUNITY'' AND market_risk_level = ''MEDIUM_RISK'' → "OPPORTUNITY: Carefully scale {marketing_channel} in {country_code} with close monitoring." • Else if opportunity_tier = ''TIER_2_OPPORTUNITY'' AND market_maturity = ''EMERGING'' → "EXPLORE: Test {marketing_channel} expansion in {country_code} - emerging market opportunity." • Else if investment_strategy = ''OPTIMIZE_OR_EXIT'' → "REVIEW: Consider exiting or major optimization of {marketing_channel} in {country_code}." • Else "MONITOR: Continue current strategy with minor optimizations." Missing values in placeholders render as empty; original casing and spacing are preserved. - success_probability: • total_opportunity_score >= 80 AND market_risk_level = ''LOW_RISK'' → ''VERY_HIGH''. • total_opportunity_score >= 60 AND market_risk_level != ''HIGH_RISK'' → ''HIGH''. • total_opportunity_score >= 40 → ''MEDIUM''. • total_opportunity_score >= 20 → ''LOW''. • Else ''VERY_LOW''. - implementation_timeline: • opportunity_tier = ''TIER_1_OPPORTUNITY'' AND market_risk_level = ''LOW_RISK'' → ''IMMEDIATE''. • opportunity_tier = ''TIER_1_OPPORTUNITY'' → ''WITHIN_30_DAYS''. • opportunity_tier = ''TIER_2_OPPORTUNITY'' → ''WITHIN_60_DAYS''. • opportunity_tier = ''TIER_3_OPPORTUNITY'' → ''WITHIN_90_DAYS''. • Else ''WHEN_RESOURCES_AVAILABLE''. - resource_requirements: • market_maturity = ''NASCENT'' → ''HIGH_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT''. • market_maturity = ''EMERGING'' → ''MEDIUM_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT''. • market_maturity IN (''DEVELOPING'',''MATURE'') → ''LOW_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT''. • Else ''STANDARD_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENT''. Output ordering: - Sort rows by total_opportunity_score descending, then expected_incremental_revenue descending, then country_code ascending, then marketing_channel ascending.'

      - name: country_code

      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region label from source; copied as-is; NULLs preserved
      - name: marketing_channel
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Marketing channel name from source; copied as-is; NULLs preserved
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month of performance; rows restricted to the last 3 months relative to the run date
      - name: active_advertisers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of active advertisers from source; no transformation; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of active campaigns from source; no transformation; NULLs preserved
      - name: campaigns_per_advertiser
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average campaigns per advertiser from source; no rounding applied; NULLs preserved
      - name: active_days_in_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of active days in performance_month from source; no transformation; NULLs preserved
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total ad impressions from source; copied as-is; NULLs preserved
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total ad clicks from source; copied as-is; NULLs preserved
      - name: current_monthly_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Renamed from total_spend; currency/unit unchanged; used in scoring and expected revenue
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total conversions from source; stored with 2 decimal places; no rounding applied
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total revenue from source; currency/unit unchanged; stored with 2 decimal places
      - name: current_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Renamed from market_ctr; CTR value as stored (ratio or percent per source); no normalization
      - name: current_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Renamed from market_cpc; cost per click; currency/unit per source; no rounding
      - name: market_cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per thousand impressions from source; currency/unit per source; no rounding
      - name: market_cpa
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per acquisition from source; currency/unit per source; no rounding
      - name: current_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Renamed from market_roas; return on ad spend ratio; copied as-is
      - name: cpc_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Variance of CPC from source; used in scoring and risk classification; copied as-is
      - name: cpc_std_dev
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of CPC from source; used in risk classification; copied as-is
      - name: market_opportunity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity level label from source (e.g., OPTIMIZATION_NEEDED); copied as-is
      - name: growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Renamed from month_over_month_spend_growth; percentage points as stored; copied as-is
      - name: market_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Market maturity stage from source (e.g., NASCENT, EMERGING, DEVELOPING, MATURE); copied as-is
      - name: spend_share_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile of spend share from source (0–1); copied as-is
      - name: performance_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Performance percentile from source (0–1); copied as-is
      - name: total_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score from four components (size, growth, performance, competition), clamped to 0–100; non-null
      - name: opportunity_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier label derived from total_spend, current_roas, growth_rate thresholds (TIER_1/2/3, MONITOR, DEPRIORITIZE); non-null
      - name: investment_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategy label derived from current_roas, growth_rate, market_maturity, cpc_variance; non-null
      - name: market_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Risk level derived from cpc_variance and cpc_std_dev (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH); non-null
      - name: budget_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Budget action derived from current_roas, performance_percentile, spend_share_percentile, market_opportunity_level; non-null
      - name: expected_incremental_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Projected incremental revenue: total_spend * multiplier * current_roas with multipliers 0.25/0.15/0.10 else 0; same currency/unit as spend'
      - name: strategic_action_plan
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Prescriptive text using fixed templates with marketing_channel and country_code; NULL inputs omitted; casing/spacing preserved
      - name: success_probability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Probability bucket from total_opportunity_score and market_risk_level (VERY_LOW to VERY_HIGH); non-null
      - name: implementation_timeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timeline bucket derived from opportunity_tier and market_risk_level (IMMEDIATE, WITHIN_30/60/90_DAYS, WHEN_RESOURCES_AVAILABLE); non-null
      - name: resource_requirements
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resource level derived from market_maturity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/STANDARD); non-null
      - name: avg_daily_platform_diversity
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Average daily platform diversity from source; copied as-is
      - name: multi_channel_advertisers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of advertisers present in multiple channels from source; copied as-is
      - name: single_channel_advertisers
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Count of advertisers present in a single channel from source; copied as-is
      - name: analysis_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp with time zone when analysis was generated in source; copied as-is

      description: Monthly campaign performance by region with pre-aggregated metrics and governance fields
      grain: One row per platform, account_id, campaign_id, region, and report_month
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__monthly_campaign_region_report
      business_logic: '- Select a monthly, region-level campaign record from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__monthly_campaign_region_report and rename columns as follows: - month_year → report_month - total_impressions → impressions - total_clicks → clicks - total_interactions → interactions - total_cost → spend - total_conversions → conversions - total_conversions_value → conversions_value - total_view_through_conversions → view_through_conversions - total_attributed_sales_14_d → attributed_sales_14_day - total_attributed_sales_30_d → attributed_sales_30_day - total_attributed_conversions_14_d → attributed_conversions_14_day - total_attributed_conversions_30_d → attributed_conversions_30_day - total_active_view_impressions → active_view_impressions - total_active_view_measurable_impressions → active_view_measurable_impressions - monthly_regional_click_through_rate → avg_ctr_percent - monthly_regional_cost_per_click → avg_cpc - monthly_regional_cost_per_thousand_impressions → avg_cpm - monthly_regional_cost_per_conversion → avg_cpa - monthly_regional_return_on_ad_spend → avg_roas - _dbt_loaded_at → data_last_updated - Pass through all other selected fields without transformation; no joins, deduplication, or additional aggregation are performed. - Filter: exclude rows where platform = ''placeholder''. - Add governance timestamp: mart_created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP at query execution time (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE). - Order the final result by platform, account_id, campaign_id, report_month DESC, spend DESC; ordering affects presentation only and does not alter row values.'
