blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__predictive_analytics
      description: Predictive analytics per platform-month with trend analysis, forecasts, risk/confidence scoring, and strategy recommendations over the last 6 months
      grain: One row per platform per performance_month (months within last 6 months)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__unified_campaign_metrics (platform, date_day, cost, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue_30d, click_through_rate, cost_per_click, return_on_ad_spend, campaign_id, lifecycle_stage)
      business_logic: '- Build the baseline from unified campaign metrics limited to the last 12 months. - Group by platform and the calendar month of date_day; compute monthly totals (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, 30-day revenue) and monthly averages (CTR rounded to 4 decimals, CPC rounded to 2, ROAS rounded to 4); all aggregations ignore NULLs. - Count distinct campaigns: active (all), new (lifecycle LAUNCH), and established (lifecycle ESTABLISHED); NULL campaign IDs are excluded. - Compute volatility as the standard deviation of CTR and CPC within each platform-month; if fewer than two non-NULL observations, volatility is NULL. - Per platform, order months chronologically to derive: - Month-over-month spend growth: percent change from the prior month (rounded to 2 decimals); if the prior value is not positive, set to 0. - Month-over-month CTR change: percent change from the prior month (rounded to 2 decimals); if the prior value is not positive, set to 0. - 3-month rolling averages for spend, CTR, and ROAS using the current month and two preceding months. - Spend momentum: ACCELERATING if current spend is >10% above prior month, DECELERATING if >10% below, otherwise STABLE; if no prior month, STABLE. - CTR momentum: IMPROVING if current CTR is >5% above prior month, DECLINING if >5% below, otherwise STABLE; if no prior month, STABLE. - Predictions: - Next-month spend: 3-month spend average scaled by 1.15 when accelerating, 0.85 when decelerating, otherwise unchanged. - Next-month CTR: 3-month CTR average scaled by 1.10 when improving, 0.90 when declining, otherwise unchanged. - Risk level: HIGH_RISK when CTR volatility > 0.5 and MoM spend growth > 50%; MEDIUM_RISK when CTR volatility > 0.3 or absolute MoM spend growth > 25%; otherwise LOW_RISK. - Anomaly probability: 35 when CTR volatility > 1.0 or CPC volatility > 2.0; 20 when CTR volatility > 0.5 or CPC volatility > 1.0; 25 when absolute MoM spend growth > 50%; otherwise 10. - Confidence: HIGH_CONFIDENCE when absolute MoM spend growth < 10% and CTR volatility < 0.3; MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE when absolute MoM spend growth < 25% and CTR volatility < 0.5; otherwise LOW_CONFIDENCE. - Final output per platform-month: - Baselines: current_monthly_spend, current_avg_ctr, current_avg_cpc, current_avg_roas from the monthly aggregates. - Budget recommendation: increase if accelerating and ROAS ≥ 2.0; decrease if decelerating or ROAS < 1.0; otherwise maintain. - Predicted ROAS: +10% when ROAS ≥ 2.5 and CTR momentum improving; −10% when ROAS < 1.5 and CTR momentum declining; otherwise unchanged. - Risk mitigation and strategic recommendation are set to the exact strings defined by the CASE rules. - Revenue scenarios: expected revenue at current ROAS = predicted spend × current avg ROAS; optimized = predicted spend × predicted ROAS; incremental = predicted spend × (predicted ROAS − current avg ROAS). - Success probability: VERY_HIGH when confidence is HIGH and risk is LOW; HIGH when confidence is HIGH/MEDIUM and risk is not HIGH; MEDIUM when confidence is MEDIUM; otherwise LOW. - Metadata: generated timestamp at query run, base date is today, target date is 30 days after the base date. - Filter to months within the last six months; results are ordered by platform ascending and performance month descending.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad platform identifier; one row per platform-month
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar month derived from date_day for the performance period
      - name: current_monthly_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total spend for the platform-month; ignores NULLs; no rounding applied
      - name: current_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR for the month rounded to 4 decimals; NULLs ignored
      - name: current_avg_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPC for the month rounded to 2 decimals; NULLs ignored
      - name: current_avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS for the month rounded to 4 decimals; NULLs ignored
      - name: mom_spend_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs prior month spend, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if prior is not positive
      - name: mom_ctr_change
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs prior month average CTR, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 if prior is not positive
      - name: spend_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ACCELERATING if spend >10% above prior month; DECELERATING if >10% below; else STABLE; no prior yields STABLE
      - name: ctr_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IMPROVING if average CTR >5% above prior; DECLINING if >5% below; else STABLE; no prior yields STABLE
      - name: predicted_next_month_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 3-month spend average scaled by momentum (1.15 if accelerating, 0.85 if decelerating; else unchanged)
      - name: predicted_next_month_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 3-month CTR average scaled by momentum (1.10 if improving, 0.90 if declining; else unchanged)
      - name: budget_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: INCREASE_BUDGET if accelerating and ROAS ≥ 2.0; DECREASE_BUDGET if decelerating or ROAS < 1.0; else MAINTAIN_BUDGET
      - name: predicted_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: ROAS +10% when ROAS ≥ 2.5 and CTR momentum improving; −10% when ROAS < 1.5 and CTR momentum declining; else unchanged
      - name: forecast_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HIGH_RISK if CTR volatility > 0.5 and MoM spend growth > 50%; MEDIUM_RISK if CTR volatility > 0.3 or absolute MoM spend growth > 25%; else LOW_RISK
      - name: anomaly_probability_next_month
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Probability bucket: 35 when CTR volatility > 1.0 or CPC volatility > 2.0; 20 when CTR volatility > 0.5 or CPC volatility > 1.0; 25 when absolute MoM spend growth > 50%; else 10'
      - name: forecast_confidence
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HIGH_CONFIDENCE if absolute MoM spend growth < 10% and CTR volatility < 0.3; MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE if absolute MoM spend growth < 25% and CTR volatility < 0.5; else LOW_CONFIDENCE
      - name: ctr_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of CTR within the platform-month; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL observations
      - name: cpc_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of CPC within the platform-month; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL observations
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of campaigns active in the platform-month; NULLs excluded
      - name: new_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of campaigns with lifecycle_stage LAUNCH in the month; NULLs excluded
      - name: established_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of campaigns with lifecycle_stage ESTABLISHED in the month; NULLs excluded
      - name: risk_mitigation_plan
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Daily monitoring/manual oversight for HIGH_RISK; weekly reviews/alerts/backup strategies when anomaly probability > 20; else standard monitoring
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategy label combining budget recommendation, risk, ROAS, CTR momentum, and anomaly risk; strings exactly as defined
      - name: expected_revenue_current_performance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × current average ROAS
      - name: expected_revenue_optimized_performance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × predicted ROAS
      - name: incremental_revenue_opportunity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted spend × (predicted ROAS − current average ROAS)
      - name: prediction_success_probability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: VERY_HIGH when confidence is HIGH and risk is LOW; HIGH when confidence HIGH/MEDIUM and risk not HIGH; MEDIUM when confidence MEDIUM; else LOW
      - name: forecast_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the query runs (timezone-aware)
      - name: forecast_base_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date when the query runs
      - name: forecast_target_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Target timestamp 30 days after the base date

optimized = predicted spend × predicted ROAS; incremental = predicted spend × (predicted ROAS − current avg ROAS). - Success probability: VERY_HIGH when confidence is HIGH and risk is LOW; HIGH when confidence is HIGH/MEDIUM and risk is not HIGH; MEDIUM when confidence is MEDIUM; otherwise LOW. - Metadata: generated timestamp at query run, base date is today, target date is 30 days after the base date. - Filter to months within the last six months; results are ordered by platform ascending and performance month descending.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__search_report using these source fields: platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, date_day, search_term, match_type, keyword_id, search_term_length, search_term_word_count, impressions, clicks, interactions, cost, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions, attributed_sales_14_d, attributed_sales_30_d, attributed_conversions_14_d, attributed_conversions_30_d, click_through_rate, cost_per_click, cost_per_thousand_impressions, cost_per_conversion, return_on_ad_spend, _dbt_loaded_at. - Exclude rows where platform equals ''placeholder''. - Rename fields: - report_date <- date_day - spend <- cost - attributed_sales_14_day <- attributed_sales_14_d - attributed_sales_30_day <- attributed_sales_30_d - attributed_conversions_14_day <- attributed_conversions_14_d - attributed_conversions_30_day <- attributed_conversions_30_d - ctr_percent <- click_through_rate - cpc <- cost_per_click - cpm <- cost_per_thousand_impressions - cpa <- cost_per_conversion - roas <- return_on_ad_spend - data_last_updated <- _dbt_loaded_at - Set these unavailable fields to NULL literals: campaign_name, ad_group_name, matched_keyword, ad_network_type, device_type, quality_score, search_impression_share, search_exact_match_impression_share, search_rank_lost_impression_share, search_budget_lost_impression_share, interaction_event_types. - Set mart_created_at to the query execution timestamp. - No aggregation or deduplication; emit remaining source rows 1:1. - Order output rows by platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, search_term, then by report_date descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: ad_reporting__url_report
      description: Business-friendly URL-level ad performance view with destination and conversion metrics; sourced from an intermediate table with selected renames, explicit NULL placeholders, and run timestamp.
      grain: One row per platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id, destination_url, report_date (as in source)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_ad_reporting__url_report
      business_logic: '- Read from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__url_report and exclude rows whose platform equals ''placeholder''. - Rename/map fields: - date_day -> report_date - url_or_product_id -> destination_url - cost -> spend - click_through_rate -> ctr_percent - cost_per_click -> cpc - cost_per_thousand_impressions -> cpm - cost_per_conversion -> cpa - return_on_ad_spend -> roas - attributed_sales_14_d -> attributed_sales_14_day - attributed_sales_30_d -> attributed_sales_30_day - attributed_conversions_14_d -> attributed_conversions_14_day - attributed_conversions_30_d -> attributed_conversions_30_day - _dbt_loaded_at -> data_last_updated - Pass through without transformation: platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id, product_sku, product_asin, url_type, impressions, clicks, interactions, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions, attributed_units_ordered_14_d, attributed_units_ordered_30_d, units_per_conversion, avg_order_value. - Set these columns to NULL (not provided by the current intermediate): campaign_name, ad_group_name, ad_name, website_domain, page_path, ad_network_type, device_type, bounce_rate, pages_per_session, avg_session_duration, landing_page_experience, mobile_friendly_click_rate, interaction_event_types. - Set data_last_updated from the source load timestamp; set mart_created_at to the model execution timestamp, identical across all rows in a run. - No aggregation, deduplication, or re-scaling is performed; duplicates are preserved; text casing/spacing and numeric precision are unchanged from source. - Output is ordered by platform, account_id, campaign_id, destination_url, then report_date descending; ordering affects presentation only.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Read from intermediate.int_ad_reporting__url_report and exclude rows whose platform equals ''placeholder''. - Rename/map fields: - date_day -> report_date - url_or_product_id -> destination_url - cost -> spend - click_through_rate -> ctr_percent - cost_per_click -> cpc - cost_per_thousand_impressions -> cpm - cost_per_conversion -> cpa - return_on_ad_spend -> roas - attributed_sales_14_d -> attributed_sales_14_day - attributed_sales_30_d -> attributed_sales_30_day - attributed_conversions_14_d -> attributed_conversions_14_day - attributed_conversions_30_d -> attributed_conversions_30_day - _dbt_loaded_at -> data_last_updated - Pass through without transformation: platform, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id, product_sku, product_asin, url_type, impressions, clicks, interactions, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions, attributed_units_ordered_14_d, attributed_units_ordered_30_d, units_per_conversion, avg_order_value. - Set these columns to NULL (not provided by the current intermediate): campaign_name, ad_group_name, ad_name, website_domain, page_path, ad_network_type, device_type, bounce_rate, pages_per_session, avg_session_duration, landing_page_experience, mobile_friendly_click_rate, interaction_event_types. - Set data_last_updated from the source load timestamp; set mart_created_at to the model execution timestamp, identical across all rows in a run. - No aggregation, deduplication, or re-scaling is performed; duplicates are preserved; text casing/spacing and numeric precision are unchanged from source. - Output is ordered by platform, account_id, campaign_id, destination_url, then report_date descending; ordering affects presentation only.'

- name: "stg_amazon_ads__ad_group_report"
      description: "Staging table for Amazon Ads  Ad Group Report"
      columns:
        - name: "platform"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "UPPER(platform) IN ('AMAZON_ADS','GOOGLE_ADS','FACEBOOK_ADS','MICROSOFT_ADS','LINKEDIN_ADS','APPLE_SEARCH_ADS','PINTEREST_ADS','REDDIT_ADS','SNAPCHAT_ADS','TIKTOK_ADS','TWITTER_ADS')"
              on_failure: delete_row

              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "REGEXP_LIKE(ad_group_id, '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "date_day"
          data_type: DATE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "date_day IS NULL OR (date_day >= '2020-01-01' AND date_day <= CURRENT_DATE)"

            - rule: "date_day IS NULL OR date_day NOT IN ('1970-01-01','1900-01-01','9999-12-31')"

        - name: "cost"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        - name: "impressions"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "click_through_rate"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "cost_per_click"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "_dbt_loaded_at"

          constraints: [not_null]

- name: "stg_apple_search_ads__ad_group_report"
      description: "Staging table for Apple Search Ads  Ad Group Report"
      columns:
        - name: "platform"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "UPPER(platform) = 'APPLE_SEARCH_ADS'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "ad_group_id"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "ad_group_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ad_group_id) != '' AND LENGTH(ad_group_id) <= 50"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "REGEXP_LIKE(ad_group_id, '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "date_day"
          data_type: DATE
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "date_day IS NOT NULL AND date_day >= '2020-01-01' AND date_day <= CURRENT_DATE"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "date_day NOT IN ('1970-01-01','1900-01-01','9999-12-31')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "impressions"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "taps"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "conversions"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "new_downloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "redownloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_new_downloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_redownloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "spend"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "spend >= 0 AND spend <= 999999999999.99"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "spend = ROUND(spend, 2)"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "spend IS NOT NULL OR spend = 0"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "spend_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: "avg_cost_per_tap"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        - name: "avg_cpt_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "avg_cpt_currency IS NULL OR avg_cpt_currency IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "LENGTH(avg_cpt_currency) <= 3"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "avg_cpt_currency = UPPER(TRIM(avg_cpt_currency))"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "avg_cost_per_acquisition"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        - name: "avg_cpa_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "avg_cpa_currency IS NULL OR avg_cpa_currency IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "LENGTH(avg_cpa_currency) <= 3"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "avg_cpa_currency = UPPER(TRIM(avg_cpa_currency))"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "tap_through_rate"
          data_type: DECIMAL(10,6)
        - name: "conversion_rate"
          data_type: DECIMAL(10,6)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "conversion_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: "lat_on_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "lat_off_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "calculated_tap_through_rate"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "cost_per_tap"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "cost_per_conversion"
          data_type: DOUBLE

      description: "Staging table for Apple Search Ads  Campaign Report"
      columns:
        - name: "platform"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "UPPER(platform) = 'APPLE_SEARCH_ADS'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "campaign_id"
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: "date_day"
          data_type: DATE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "date_day IS NOT NULL AND date_day >= '2020-01-01' AND date_day <= CURRENT_DATE"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "date_day NOT IN ('1970-01-01','1900-01-01','9999-12-31')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: "impressions"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "taps"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "conversions"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "new_downloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "redownloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_new_downloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "tap_redownloads"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "spend"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "spend >= 0 AND spend <= 999999999999.99"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "spend = ROUND(spend, 2)"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "spend IS NOT NULL OR spend = 0"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "spend_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: "avg_cost_per_tap"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        - name: "avg_cpt_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "avg_cpt_currency IS NULL OR avg_cpt_currency IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "LENGTH(avg_cpt_currency) <= 3"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "avg_cpt_currency = UPPER(TRIM(avg_cpt_currency))"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "avg_cost_per_acquisition"
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        - name: "avg_cpa_currency"
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "avg_cpa_currency IS NULL OR avg_cpa_currency IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "LENGTH(avg_cpa_currency) <= 3"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "avg_cpa_currency = UPPER(TRIM(avg_cpa_currency))"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: "tap_through_rate"
          data_type: DECIMAL(10,6)
        - name: "conversion_rate"
          data_type: DECIMAL(10,6)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "conversion_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: "lat_on_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "lat_off_installs"
          data_type: INTEGER
        - name: "calculated_tap_through_rate"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "cost_per_tap"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "cost_per_conversion"
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: "_dbt_loaded_at"
          data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "_dbt_loaded_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
              on_failure: delete_row
